raw.excerpt: About Misfits Market:Misfits Market is a mission-driven, high-growth startup dedicated to reducing food waste and making shopping for sustainable, high-quality groceries easier and more affordable.
raw.description:
About Misfits Market:

Misfits Market is a mission-driven, high-growth startup dedicated to reducing food waste and making shopping for sustainable, high-quality groceries easier and more affordable. We deliver organic produce, high-quality meats and seafood, plant-based proteins, dairy, bakery, wine, and other grocery items to nearly every zip code in 48 states at up to 30 percent off traditional grocery store prices. In 2022, Misfits Market acquired sustainable e-grocer Imperfect Foods and now leverages its in-house transportation network to deliver directly to consumers with one of the most carbon-efficient grocery delivery models on the market. By tackling inefficiencies in the food system, our passionate and motivated team of problem solvers helps save an average of 500,000 pounds of food per week from waste or lesser outcomes, with an all-time savings of 190+ million pounds of food.

As Misfits we support our customers and mission by embracing our core values of:

Prioritizing our Customers

Doing more with less

Thinking Differently

Respecting one another

Moving deliberately and quickly

Taking initiative and delivering

About the team:

The Data Analytics team is a pivotal part of the organization, closely collaborating with major stakeholders across the company including Product, Finance, Operations, Growth Marketing, Merchandising, and Logistics. Our primary goal is to craft insightful reporting on key metrics, empowering immediate and impactful actions. We are recognized as trusted advisors, having a significant voice in guiding the strategic direction of these departments.

As a team, we foster both specialization and generalization. Each team member serves as a point of contact for a specific department, ensuring tailored support and expertise. Simultaneously, we emphasize a broad understanding of all departments we work with. This ensures a cohesive, supportive environment where knowledge is shared, and support and collaboration is common.

About the role:

As a Senior Data Analyst, Experimentation at Misfits Market, you’ll serve as the company’s go-to expert on experimental design and causal inference, while remaining hands-on with stakeholder dashboarding needs. You’ll help evolve our experimentation culture by designing and evaluating controlled experiments, developing models to improve and simplify dashboard development, and mentor analysts on designing experiments and interpreting results.

Responsibilities:

  • Own experimentation analytics. Design, monitor and interpret A/B and multivariate tests across Product and Marketing
  • Partner with Product Managers and Marketing leads to prioritize experiments using frameworks like ICE or PIE
  • Translate experimental results into business recommendations
  • Collaborate with engineering to ensure consistent event tracking and instrumentation design
  • Develop internal experimentation frameworks. Build dbt models and dashboards that automate experiment tracking, power statistical analyses, and improve interpretability.
  • Mentor analysts: guide the team in best practices for causal inference, power analysis, metric selection, and communicating uncertainty.
  • Improve data infrastructure: maintain and improve dbt models, metrics definitions, and self-serve data assets.
  • Develop descriptive reporting dashboards across Product, Merchandising, and other teams
  • Dive into complex SQL and break down problems
  • Identify areas of opportunity to move from descriptive to predictive analytics, and ad-hoc to self-serve reporting
  • Maintain analytics roadmap to prioritize initiatives, communicate timelines, and ensure successful, timely completion of deliverables

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field with 3+ years of relevant experience, or Bachelor’s degree in the same fields with 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Expert-level SQL skills - you are comfortable writing complex queries and optimizing for performance
  • Deep understanding of experiment design, causal inference, and statistical testing
  • Experience with dbt and data modeling best practices
  • Proficiency with Python or R for statistical analysis
  • Experience with visualization tools, such as Mode, Tableau, PowerBI, etc
  • Experience with data pipelines - have created and/or are comfortable communicating ETL needs to engineering
  • Strong communication skills - you can gather user stories and translate data insights to stakeholders of varying levels of technical knowledge
  • Experience working as part of a cross-functional data team

Preferred / Nice to have:

  • Prior experience in e-commerce or lifecycle marketing

Details of Position & Benefits:

  • Salary range $120,000 - $135,000
  • Full-time exempt position
  • 100 % Remote Work
  • Salary and employee stock options commensurate with experience
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Multiple health, dental, and vision plan options
  • Life Insurance
  • 401K plan

raw.description:
lust auf neue herausforderungen?

Du kennst TYPO3 in- und auswendig, fühlst dich auch in WordPress zu Hause und siehst sofort, wenn auf dem Smartphone ein Button verrutscht? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Als Freelance Webentwickler (m/w/d) bei zahneins, dem führenden Partner für Zahnärzt*innen in Deutschland, sorgst du dafür, dass die Websites unserer Praxen sowie unsere eigene reibungslos funktionieren und gut aussehen. Du baust nach Auftrag Landingpages für Kampagnen, bindest Buchungstools und Schnittstellen an und behebst Fehler, bevor sie jemandem auffallen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, wie Patientinnen und Patienten an über 80 Standorten ihren Termin buchen und wie Fachkräfte den Weg in unsere Teams finden.

perspektiven:

  • Vollständig remote: Arbeite, von wo du willst
  • Flexible Zeiten: Du teilst dir deine Arbeit selbst ein, solange Tickets zuverlässig und zeitnah bearbeitet werden
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit: Wir suchen keine Einmal-Lösung, sondern einen festen technischen Partner mit regelmäßiger Auslastung
  • Vielfalt statt Routine: Über 80 Praxis-Websites mit eigenen Identitäten, Kampagnen-Landingpages und Integrationen
  • Klare Tickets und kurze Wege: Anfragen laufen strukturiert über E-Mail bzw. unser Ticketsystem, Rückfragen klärst du direkt mit dem Team
  • Starkes Umfeld: Du arbeitest mit unserem SEO-Spezialisten, unserer Art Direction und einem wertschätzenden Marketing-Team zusammen
  • Moderner Stack: Composer-basiertes TYPO3 mit Content Blocks, lokale Docker-Umgebungen und ein gepflegtes Sitepackage mit zentralem SCSS und wiederverwendbaren Komponenten. Alles liegt versioniert in Git, pro Ticket gibt es einen eigenen Branch mit Merge Request und Review vor dem Livegang.
  • Raum für Ideen: Wenn du Wege siehst, Abläufe zu automatisieren oder Seiten besser zu machen, hören wir zu

aufgaben:

  • Umsetzung von Tickets aus dem Marketing-Team: Anpassungen an Inhalten, Buttons, Links und Layouts
  • Entwicklung von Landingpages, Pop-ups und Störern, nach Designvorlage oder mit eigenem gestalterischen Gespür
  • Integration von Drittanbieter-Diensten wie Online-Terminbuchung, Social-Media-Feeds oder Formularen
  • Aufspüren und Beheben von Darstellungsfehlern auf Desktop und Mobil
  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer WordPress-Seiten, unter anderem für den zahneins Campus
  • Perspektivisch und nach Absprache: Updates, Extension-Pflege und Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unseres TYPO3-Systems
Technisches SEO, strukturierte Daten und Tracking verantwortet unser SEO-Spezialist. Bei Änderungen mit Auswirkungen auf Rankings, URLs oder das Tracking stimmst du dich mit ihm ab. So kannst du dich voll auf eine saubere technische Umsetzung konzentrieren.

profil:

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Schrift: Deutsch muss nicht deine Muttersprache sein. Wichtig ist, dass du unsere Tickets und Anforderungen sicher verstehst, gerne auch mit Unterstützung von Übersetzungstools.
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der TYPO3-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit TYPO3 12/13, Fluid, TypoScript und Content Blocks
  • Erfahrung mit TYPO3-Multisite-Installationen und Site Configurations
  • Sicherer Umgang mit PHP 8.x, HTML5, CSS/SCSS und JavaScript
  • Erfahrung in der Anbindung externer Dienste und Schnittstellen (z. B. Buchungs-Widgets, XML/JSON-Feeds, REST-APIs)
  • Solide WordPress-Kenntnisse, inklusive Theme-Anpassungen und Plugin-Entwicklung
  • Mobile-first-Denken und sauberes Responsive Design
  • Gespür für Webdesign: Du setzt Layouts aus Figma oder PDF präzise um und findest auch ohne detaillierte Vorlage eine visuell stimmige Lösung
  • Ein Auge für Details: Du bemerkst Anzeigefehler, bevor sie gemeldet werden, und testest auf verschiedenen Geräten und Browsern
  • Saubere Einbindung: Du schreibst semantisches HTML mit klarer Überschriftenstruktur, Alt-Texten und aussagekräftigen Linktexten und bindest externe Widgets consent-konform und asynchron ein, ohne dass das Layout springt.
  • Workflow: Sicherer Umgang mit Git (Branches, Merge Requests), Composer und Docker-basierten Entwicklungsumgebungen
  • Performance als Handwerkszeug: Du prüfst deine Umsetzung mit Lighthouse bzw. PageSpeed, kennst die Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) und lieferst Bilder responsiv in modernen Formaten aus (srcset, WebP/AVIF, gezieltes Lazy Loading).
  • Qualitätsbewusstsein: Für dich gehört zu einer guten Umsetzung, dass sie schlank, performant und langfristig wartbar ist. Du baust auf vorhandenen Komponenten auf, orientierst dich an PSR-12 und den TYPO3 Coding Guidelines und setzt Inhalte so um, dass die Redaktion sie selbst pflegen kann.
  • Zuverlässigkeit: Du reagierst auf neue Tickets innerhalb eines Werktags und gibst transparent Rückmeldung, auch wenn eine Lösung etwas länger dauert. Kritische Fehler, etwa eine ausgefallene Online-Terminbuchung, packst du möglichst noch am selben Tag an

neugierig geworden?

Interessiert? Dann melde dich gerne direkt bei uns mit einer kurzen Vorstellung, Referenzen oder Links zu TYPO3-Projekten, an denen du mitgearbeitet hast, deiner Stundensatzvorstellung und deiner verfügbaren Kapazität pro Woche. Zeig uns gern ein Projekt, auf dessen Umsetzung und Performance du besonders stolz bist. Lass uns gemeinsam herausfinden, wie wir am besten zusammenarbeiten können!

Bei Fragen steht dir gerne Marie Asbrand zur Verfügung: 0151 17595887

über uns

Wir sind zahneins, der führende Dentalverbund in Deutschland mit über 80 Standorten und mehr als 2.400 Mitarbeitenden. Seit unserer Gründung 2016 setzen wir auf Innovation, Qualität und partnerschaftliches Miteinander. Unsere Werte Teamstärke, Leidenschaft, Qualitätsstreben, Innovation und Integrität sind dabei nicht nur Buzzwords, sondern der Kern unserer Kultur.

raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Power BI / Microsoft Fabric Developer to design and build end-to-end analytics solutions supporting our supply chain and manufacturing operations. You will work closely with business stakeholders to transform data from SAP ERP and other systems into dashboards and semantic models that drive better decisions.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and Fabric solutions with a focus on performance, usability, and storytelling.
  • Translate supply chain and manufacturing requirements into data models and visualizations such as inventory, production, procurement, logistics, OEE, OTIF, lead times, and supplier performance.
  • Ingest and transform data from SAP ERP and other systems into curated data marts and datasets using SQL, Power Query, and Fabric or Azure data services.
  • Write and optimize SQL, DAX, and where relevant MDX queries, including performance tuning and debugging.
  • Implement and maintain ETL and ELT processes to ensure timely and high-quality data delivery.
  • Work with supply chain, manufacturing, and finance stakeholders to understand processes and KPIs, refine requirements, and improve dashboards.
  • Apply BI best practices for data modeling, semantic layer design, row-level security, usability, and governance.
  • Integrate data from APIs and web services to enrich datasets and automate refreshes.
  • Document solutions and provide handover and training when needed.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience developing reports and dashboards with Microsoft Power BI and the Microsoft data stack.
  • Strong ability to write complex SQL, DAX, and optionally MDX queries.
  • Experience with query optimization and performance troubleshooting.
  • Proven experience building interactive dashboards and impactful visualizations.
  • Solid experience in data analysis, data modeling, and data mart design.
  • Understanding of data warehousing concepts and analytical architectures.
  • Practical experience with SAP ERP data in a supply chain or manufacturing context, ideally including MM, SD, and PP.
  • Working knowledge of ETL tools and technologies such as Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Informatica, DataStage, Talend, or similar.
  • Experience with Azure data services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, Azure Blob or ADLS storage, or Fabric lake houses and pipelines.
  • Experience integrating data from APIs and web services.

Language(s) :

  • Spanish native
  • English fluent

raw.description:
Hello! ✨

We’re Wildix, a global leader in Unified Communications & Collaboration as a Service (UCaaS) and we’re on a mission to redefine how businesses connect. Our secure, web-based and AI-powered solutions help companies around the world collaborate smarter, serve customers better and grow stronger — and we want you to help shape what’s next.

About Us…

In 2005, brothers Dimitri and Steve Osler set out to reimagine how businesses communicate, and that vision became Wildix. Today, from our headquarters in Tallinn, Estonia, Wildix is one of the world’s fastest-growing UCaaS companies, with 300+ team members from 15+ nationalities, working across Europe, the UK, the Americas and beyond. We serve businesses in 135+ countries through a partner-first ecosystem, delivering secure, intuitive solutions that keep companies connected, productive and ready for what’s next.

At Wildix, we don’t just build technology, we live it. As a remote-first company, we rely on our own platform every day to collaborate globally and innovate fast. With steady growth and a strong foundation, we offer real opportunities to advance your career as we scale, making an impact in a global team that’s shaping the future of work.

At Wildix, our mission is clear: Empower companies worldwide with seamless communication solutions that drive productivity, efficiency, and growth.

About The Role

We're building the AI layer of business communication — voice agents, chat agents and AI assistants that work in real customer conversations and real phone calls across 135+ countries.

You'll join our AI Agents stream, an 8-person engineering team owning the product end to end. You'll build the agents themselves as well as the platform behind them: skills, workflows, tools, connectors, orchestration, observability and the infrastructure that makes AI reliable, fast and measurable in production.

This is a hands-on product engineering role for someone who wants to build real AI products, not just integrate AI APIs.

What You Will Do

  • Build and ship AI agent features end to end — from Node.js/TypeScript services on AWS to the interfaces used to configure, test and observe agents.
  • Extend the AI agent platform — building skills, workflows, sandboxes, tools, connectors, tracing, audit and orchestration capabilities.
  • Integrate and orchestrate AI providers — LLM, STT and TTS — using prompt and context engineering, tool calling, structured outputs, streaming and robust failure handling.
  • Make AI quality measurable and production-ready — build evaluations, tracing and monitoring while engineering for latency, reliability, cost, privacy and security.
  • Drive product discovery and ownership — challenge scope, propose solutions, bring your own ideas and stay involved after release by using quality and adoption signals to iterate.
  • Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, architecture decisions, knowledge sharing and collaboration across the AI Agents stream.

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js backend skills and confidence working across the frontend with React or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered features used by real users in production. You should be able to explain what you built, how it worked and the engineering decisions behind it.
  • Practical experience with AI application patterns including prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, RAG, streaming and handling non-deterministic behaviour in production.
  • Experience making AI systems measurable and observable through evaluations, tracing, monitoring and regression detection.
  • Strong production AWS experience with serverless and/or containerized environments. Our stack includes Lambda/SAM, ECS, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS and OpenSearch.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals across REST/API design, WebSockets, SQL and NoSQL data modelling, caching, testing, CI/CD and production debugging.
  • A strong ownership and product mindset — you take initiative, challenge assumptions, work comfortably with ambiguity and turn ideas into shipped features rather than waiting for detailed specifications.
  • English B2 or above.

Bonus Points If

  • You've built agentic systems involving multi-step orchestration, tool selection, state management, guardrails or recovery from failures.
  • You've worked in security- or privacy-sensitive environments, including GDPR or ISO 27001.
  • You have public evidence of building for the sake of building — open-source contributions, side projects, technical writing, talks or similar.
  • You have experience with real-time audio and communication technologies, such as WebRTC, streaming STT/TTS or low-latency voice pipelines.

Why You’ll Love It Here

👫 Work with a Supportive, High-Performing Team – We believe in trust, autonomy, and working with bright, passionate individuals who drive real impact.

🌍 A Truly International Workplace – Our diverse and inclusive team ensures you’ll always feel connected and supported, no matter where you are.

🚀 Shape the Future of Global Communication – Be part of a team transforming how businesses operate in an era of remote work and AI-powered collaboration.

💼 Join a Profitable & Stable Company – We’re not a startup experiment, we’re a two decade old success story with sustained profitability, meaning we can back your boldest ideas.

What we offer

🏖️ Flexible Time Off – Take the breaks you need to relax, recharge, and come back inspired.

💻 Top-Tier Tech – Love Mac? So do we! We equip our team with the best tools for success.

🚀 Career Growth & Development – Access to programs and events to keep you at the top of your game.

💰 Compensation – The total compensation for this role is between EUR 48,000 and EUR 60,000 per year. The final offer will fall within this range, and reflects the candidate’s skills, experience, and work location.

🌱 Well-being Support – We offer access to psychology sessions to support your mental and emotional health

Happy with them? We offer even more! Our Benefits are country-specific, you can ask your recruiter for more information

Interview Process

🤝 Step 1: Initial Screening – 30 mins| A chat with our Talent Team to understand your background, experience, and motivations.

🛠️ Step 2: Technical Interview – 60 mins| A technical deep dive with your potential Manager and Principal Engineer to assess your skills and fit for the role.

🎯 Step 3: Final Interview – 30 mins| A conversation with leadership to ensure alignment with our values and mission.

We Are Wildix

Wildix is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome all applicants regardless of race, gender, age, religion, or any other characteristic. Everyone is encouraged to apply and is welcome to join our Blue Ecosystem.

Ready to join us? Apply Now!

This is a high-impact role where your commercial expertise and industry knowledge will directly shape how Danfoss supports the future of metals manufacturing across North America.

  • Proven success building strategic relationships with metals producers and key plant stakeholders across engineering, operations, maintenance, and procurement functions.
  • Confident communicator who can effectively engage both technical and commercial decision-makers and influence complex purchasing decisions.

raw.description:
NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars.

Come work for the team that brought to you NCCL, NVSHMEM & GPUDirect. Our GPU communication libraries are crucial for scaling Deep Learning and HPC applications! We are looking for a motivated Performance engineer to influence the roadmap of our communication libraries. The DL and HPC applications of today have a huge compute demand and run on scales which go up to tens of thousands of GPUs. The GPUs are connected with high-speed interconnects (eg. NVLink, PCIe) within a node and with high-speed networking (eg. Infiniband, Ethernet) across the nodes. Communication performance between the GPUs has a direct impact on the end-to-end application performance; and the stakes are even higher at huge scales! This is an outstanding opportunity for someone with HPC and performance background to advance the state of the art in this space. Are you ready for to contribute to the development of innovative technologies and help realize NVIDIA's vision?

What you will be doing:

  • Conduct in-depth performance characterization and analysis on large multi-GPU and multi-node clusters.

  • Study the interaction of our libraries with all HW (GPU, CPU, Networking) and SW components in the stack

  • Evaluate proof-of-concepts, conduct trade-off analysis when multiple solutions are available

  • Triage and root-cause performance issues reported by our customers

  • Collect a lot of performance data; build tools and infrastructure to visualize and analyze the information

  • Collaborate with a very dynamic team across multiple time zones

What we need to see:

  • M.S. (or equivalent experience) or PHD in Computer Science, or related field with relevant performance engineering and HPC experience

  • 3+ yrs of experience with parallel programming and at least one communication runtime (MPI, NCCL, UCX, NVSHMEM)

  • Experience conducting performance benchmarking and triage on large scale HPC clusters

  • Good understanding of computer system architecture, HW-SW interactions and operating systems principles (aka systems software fundamentals)

  • Implement micro-benchmarks in C/C++, read and modify the code base when required

  • Ability to debug performance issues across the entire HW/SW stack. Proficient in a scripting language, preferably Python

  • Familiar with containers, cloud provisioning and scheduling tools (Kubernetes, SLURM, Ansible, Docker)

  • Adaptability and passion to learn new areas and tools. Flexibility to work and communicate effectively across different teams and timezones

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Practical experience with Infiniband/Ethernet networks in areas like RDMA, topologies, congestion control

  • Experience debugging network issues in large scale deployments

  • Familiarity with CUDA programming and/or GPUs

  • Experience with Deep Learning Frameworks such PyTorch, TensorFlow

NVIDIA is at the forefront of breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our teams are composed of driven, innovative professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We offer highly competitive salaries, an extensive benefits package, and a work environment that promotes diversity, inclusion, and flexibility. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a supportive and empowering workplace for all.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 221,250 PLN - 383,500 PLN for Level 3, and 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN for Level 4.

Raptor’s globally integrated product portfolio supports a school’s foundation of safety and wellbeing, including Emergency Management, Campus Movement, Student Wellbeing and Safety Training and Compliance.

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Sales Operations Coordinator to join our team. This role focuses on building accurate quotes in Salesforce CPQ and collaborating cross-functionally with Contracts, Legal, and Finance to ensure smooth deal handoffs. We welcome candidates with strong analytics, documentation, and process-optimization experience who can quickly ramp in CPQ—extensive tenured CPQ background is not required.

This is a 4 month temporary, full time position (40 hours/week).There is potential for an assignment extension, which will be discussed towards the end of the engagement.

Responsibilities

  • Quote Creation & Delivery
    • Configure Salesforce CPQ quotes from Sales inputs (products, quantities, term lengths), ensuring line-item subscription ARR is correctly calculated.
    • Apply standard discount rules based on established rate cards; flag any nonstandard discount requests for approval.
    • Generate and distribute final quote documents (PDF/Word) to Sales reps within the agreed SLA (typically < 24 business hours).
  • Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Liaise with Contracts to confirm that all standard SLAs, T&Cs, and contract language are reflected in each quote as needed.
    • Work with Legal on any special contract language or exceptions, documenting and routing those items promptly as required.
    • Partner with Finance to validate billing frequencies, subscription tiers, and revenue details before quote issuance on demand.
  • Quote Validation & Process Compliance
    • Conduct detailed reviews of each quote for completeness—verifying product configurations, term selections, and discount accuracy.
    • Document any manual adjustments or exceptions (e.g., custom discount reasons) in Salesforce.
  • Documentation & Process Improvement
    • Author clear, step-by-step operating procedures for CPQ processes, drawing on experience with SOPs and process optimization.
    • Maintain version control of quote templates and CPQ configuration guides, ensuring the latest standards are always in use.
    • Identify recurring pain points or process gaps; recommend and help implement small enhancements (e.g., field-level help text in CPQ) to reduce quote errors and accelerate turnaround.
  • Sales Support & Communication
    • Serve as a primary CPQ resource for Sales reps—answering questions about bundling rules, term options, and standard discount guidelines.
    • Provide timely status updates on quote progress, including approvals pending with Contracts, Legal, or Finance.
    • Escalate critical issues (e.g., missing approvals, pricing mismatches) proactively to Sales Operations leadership.

Qualifications (Required):

  • Familiarity with Salesforce Revenue Cloud and/or Salesforce CPQ
  • Experience with Gong
  • Proven ability to partner seamlessly with Contracts, Legal, Finance (or comparable teams) to resolve process questions and ensure all stakeholders are aligned.
  • Demonstrated track record of authoring standard operating procedures and streamlining workflows—ideally reducing cycle times (e.g., as seen with material-creation optimizations).
  • Strong data-analysis aptitude (e.g., using Excel, Power BI) and high attention to detail, ensuring ≥ 98 % quote-accuracy rates.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication—capable of drafting playbook updates, conveying status to Sales reps, and coordinating multi-department handoffs.
  • Self-starter who can juggle multiple concurrent quote requests, prioritize by deal size or close date, and ask clarifying questions when needed.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Comfortable with ARR concepts, contract terms (annual vs. multi-year), and basic billing configurations—able to translate Sales requirements into CPQ‐compatible specs.

raw.description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

Location Preference: Remote (US preferred, ET and CT timezones ideal)

About The Role:

As a Associate Marketing Manager at Fingerprint, you'll own the execution of our event and webinar campaigns from start to finish — building the emails, landing pages, and campaign assets that bring our strategy to life. You'll work in close, day-to-day partnership with our Performance Marketing Manager, who sets strategic direction and provides execution guidance, while also collaborating cross-functionally with Demand Generation, Field Marketing, Design, Sales, and Operations to launch campaigns that run smoothly, stay on schedule, and deliver a great experience for prospects and customers.

You'll be responsible for managing webinar logistics, coordinating campaign timelines, and ensuring every campaign is executed with attention to detail — from QA to reporting on performance. This role is ideal for someone who's organized, enjoys owning projects, and is eager to grow their execution skills in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end execution of webinar and event marketing campaigns
  • Build, QA, and launch emails, landing pages, forms, and workflows in HubSpot
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and keep stakeholders aligned on deliverables and deadlines
  • Manage webinar logistics, including registration pages, reminder emails, attendee communications, and post-event follow-up
  • Build and launch supporting campaigns across email and paid channels
  • Partner with Design and Content teams to ensure campaign assets are delivered on schedule
  • Partner with the BDR team to align event follow-up, lead activation, and post-event outreach
  • Build pre-event target lists and audience segments to support campaign execution
  • Own campaign reporting and performance analysis, maintaining accurate data in HubSpot and Salesforce while turning insights into recommendations for optimization.
  • Own campaign QA before launch to ensure emails, landing pages, forms, and workflows are working as expected
  • Support campaign optimization by testing new ideas and identifying opportunities to improve event performance.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in B2B campaign marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or a similar marketing role
  • Experience building emails, landing pages, forms, and workflows in HubSpot
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and how marketing campaigns are managed in a CRM
  • You have a test-and-learn mindset—you never settle for "good enough" and are constantly experimenting with new tactics, channels, and messaging to improve results.
  • Some experience supporting paid digital campaigns (LinkedIn, Meta, or similar platforms)
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and consistently meet deadlines
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal day-to-day direction
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proactive, resourceful, and eager to learn
  • Role requires proficiency with macOS and comfort working fully remotely using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom Webinar, and Asana

Compensation & Transparency

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $59,000 - $80,000.

Some example salaries for specific locations are below:

New York City: $70,000 - $80,000

Chicago: $59,000 - $68,000

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.

If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here.

If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here.

**We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Fingerprint recruiting email communications will always come from the @fingerprint.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Fingerprint via other sources should be ignored.

Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Solutions Consultant to join our team at Caseware, a leading SaaS organization. As a Solutions Consultant, you will play a critical role in ensuring our largest strategic customers are successful in their evaluations and implementations of Caseware solutions. In this role, you will strategise with customers on their goals, evaluations and implementations, understand their ongoing needs, design and maintain project plans, address customers’ questions pulling in SME’s, and provide consultative support across all aspects of a customer’s evaluation and implementation process. You will also liaise with team members in sales, account management, training ,support and product, as well as with our strategic partners, to help ensure key customer needs are addressed ona timely basis, and professionally.
You will work closely with in international teams to assist and contribute ideas in moving toward a global process within the solutions consulting team.
📍 Location:
The role is a remote role and is available to all applicants residing and eligible to work in the UK. There may be requirements to travel to various offices around the UK or internationally depending on client needs.
Dana Liulica - Talent Acquisition Partner

What you will be doing:

  • Partner with our Strategic Account Managers in helping our prospects and customers evaluate and implement Caseware products.
  • Strategize with customers on their evaluation & implementation journeys, identifying needs (e.g. communications, change management, training, champion and support strategy etc.) and working with them to develop a project plan to ensure key requirements are addressed.
  • Create and maintain product demo strategies and related assets that are value and benefit-driven, not feature walk throughs.
  • Support customer evaluations and implementations, providing information on tools, processes and resources to customers, and helping to ensure timelines and tasks remain on track.
  • Assist in the development and execution of customer migration strategies from their existing accounting and audit platforms to Caseware’s suite of cloud solutions.
  • Coordinate internally to address customer issues not handled through existing support channels (e.g. coordination of access, licenses, account maintenance, escalating support).
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of a product knowledge base for team members to access as a supplemental resource to the SC team.
  • Capture, and where appropriate respond to, customer and prospect feedback relating to product and sales experience to support continued innovation.
  • Create and maintain toolkits and resources to support customer evaluations and implementations, working with other Caseware teams as relevant.
  • Design and implementation of processes and systems to support the delivery of consistent, scalable services. Assist in the development and execution of improvement plans internally that are scalable to support future growth.
  • Attend key industry trade shows and events.
  • Participate in speaking engagements and thought leadership events as comfortable.

What you will bring:

  • At least 4 years’ experience working in an Audit/Accounting/Professional Services Firm performing External Audit or Assurance engagement or at least 5 years’ experience in customer facing role (e.g. customer success, account management, implementation, product or project management) in a SAAS company serving the Accounting Profession.
  • Excellent written, oral communication and presentation skills.
  • Effective communicator with ability to understand and interpret stakeholder needs.
  • Strong organization skills with experience tracking and managing multiple deliverables and tasks.
  • A resourceful self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment where initiative and problem-solving skills are required.
  • Have a sound understanding of technology within the audit and accountancy sector, or an enthusiasm to learn.
  • Nice to have: Chartered Accountant (or equivalent) with 5+ years of external audit experience, ideally with hands-on use of CaseWare; background in audit innovation, training, or tech adoption within a firm; strong understanding of financial processes, project/product management, CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce), and experience collaborating with product, marketing, or sales teams.

What's in it for you:

▪️Innovation is at our core. We work with cutting-edge technology in accounting and financial reporting, constantly pushing the boundaries to create impactful software solutions.
▪️We are committed to a collaborative culture, where your ideas are valued, and knowledge sharing is encouraged within a supportive, inclusive team.
▪️Work-life balance is important to us. We offer flexible work options, remote opportunities, and generous time-off policies to ensure a healthy work-life balance.
▪️We offer competitive compensation, including a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits
▪️We are driven by impactful work. Your contributions directly affect how our clients manage financial processes and drive their success.
▪️Recognition and rewards matter to us. We celebrate hard work through recognition programs, performance bonuses, and opportunities for career growth.
▪️We embrace global opportunities. Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team.

About Caseware:

Caseware's cutting-edge software products are meticulously designed for accounting firms, corporations, and governments. Our teams are continually collaborating, innovating, and building upon our existing suite of products. With a customer-focused mindset, we are building technology that is shaping what the future of audits, financial reporting, and financial data analytics will look like.
With a recent strategic investment from Hg Capital in 2020, Caseware is now in its next major growth phase as we double down on the people and products that have made Caseware so successful to date.
One of Caseware's core values is Many Voices, One Team and with that in mind, we're dedicated to building teams as diverse as our customers in an equitable and inclusive way. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Should you require accommodations or have any questions at any point during the application or interview process, please e-mail our People Operations team at .

Background Check:

Any candidates successful in obtaining an offer for a position will need to successfully complete a background check through Certn.co which typically includes an Identity Verification and Criminal Record Check. Executives and Senior Managers will undergo a Soft Credit Check as well. Candidates residing in the Netherlands and Germany are excluded from undergoing background checks via Certn.co

Security and Fraud:

Caseware takes the security of candidates seriously. All legitimate communication from us will come from email addresses ending in @caseware.com and our open positions are always listed on reputable job boards and on our website We will NEVER ask for payment or financial information from you. If you receive an unsolicited job offer, proceed with extreme caution.

Founded in 2018 and headquartered in The Netherlands, GT Ecom BV is on a mission to build the most efficient global direct-to-consumer infrastructure and become the world’s largest e-commerce company—powered by a collective of successful, scalable brands. By 2026, we’re aiming to achieve $500 million in revenue and operate over 50 thriving online stores worldwide.

With a team of 160+ top-tier remote e-commerce professionals across the globe, we blend local brand experiences with cross-border logistics, ensuring every customer feels connected—no matter where they are.

At our core, we value hard work, freedom with responsibility, constant improvement, and a mindset of positivity. We believe in building a high-performance, remote-first culture where honesty, excellence, and creativity drive everything we do—because the future of work is global, and we’re building it together.

The Upsides of Working with Us

💪 Hard Work That Matters

We’re surrounded by people who care deeply and give their best. We don’t settle for average—we show up, push boundaries, and aim high. That shared drive creates momentum and meaning in everything we do.

🔓 Freedom with Responsibility

You have the freedom to choose how, when, and where you work—but freedom only thrives when it’s paired with ownership. We trust you to manage your time, meet your commitments, and take responsibility for your impact.

📚 Constant Improvement

Growth is part of our DNA. We believe in learning, evolving, and getting 1% better every day. Whether it’s a new skill, a fresh mindset, or sharper execution—stagnation isn’t in our vocabulary.

🌞 Positivity by Default

We approach people, problems, and communication with a positive mindset. That means giving the benefit of the doubt, staying constructive, and keeping energy high—even when challenges arise.

🗣️ Honesty & Transparency

We believe the fastest way to move forward is through clear, honest communication. No politics. No guessing games. Just straight talk that builds trust and strengthens our team.

🏆 Excellence Is the Baseline

We hold ourselves and each other to a high standard—not out of pressure, but out of pride. We care too much about what we’re building to accept "good enough." Excellence is the expectation.

🎯 Creativity Welcome Here

We encourage bold ideas, fast testing, and open collaboration. Failure doesn’t scare us—comfort does. That’s why creativity is valued as a core ingredient in everything from product to process.

We’re on the lookout for a Supply Chain Project Lead to take charge of critical initiatives that shape the future of our operations.

The Challenge

As we take on more complex initiatives across our supply chain, we’re facing a gap in project leadership — we need strong, strategic minds who can not only plan but also drive execution to results. You'll be stepping in to lead high-impact projects from strategy to implementation, ensuring we’re resourced properly, aligned on priorities, and seeing real progress. If you’re someone who thrives on turning ideas into action and keeping cross-functional teams moving, this role is for you.

Early Success Milestones for this role

  • Able to understand the ins and outs of the supply chain operations
  • Deliver results by leading 1-2 Kaizen projects

Your Team When You Join Us

You’ll be part of our Supply Chain Team, made up of 28 team members, all reporting directly to our Supply Chain Manager based in China. You will also lead 2 direct reports. It’s a fast-paced, collaborative team focused on driving operational excellence across our global e-commerce operations.

We would love to hear from you if…

  • You have 5–10 years of experience in supply chain or logistics, ideally within cross-border e-commerce operations.
  • You've worked in a top-tier e-commerce company (e.g. Alibaba Level 5+, TikTok Level 2-1+)and understand how high-performing supply chain teams operate at scale.
  • Shopify experience is a big plus!
  • You’re confident with project management, data analysis, and working with ERP/WMS systems to drive decisions and improvements.
  • You can use English as a working language. Fluent writing and reading is acceptable if the rest of your experience is a strong fit.
  • You’re organized, meticulous, and a critical thinker who can communicate clearly and drive results.
  • You’ve worked with SQL, Python, dbt, BI tools, ETL tools like Fivetran or Airbyte, or alerting tools like Monte Carlo or Airflow(not required but a plus).
Couple of the notes about the role
  • This is not a salaried position. This is an Independent Contractor role.
  • This role is only for candidates who are currently based in China.
  • You must be able to commit at least 8 hours per day, 40 hours per week.
  • We require everybody in the team to use Hubstaff () to track hours worked.

Compensation

  • 10-20 EUR/hour + performance bonus + 75 EUR for health stipend on your third month

If you are excited about the opportunity and feel like you are a good fit, we encourage you to apply today and talk to one of our recruiters. We look forward to seeing how your skills and experiences align with our vision.

This role will lead the development and independent 3rd-party verification of GHG inventories (Scope 1, 2, and 3) and related water, waste, and energy data in line with standards, such as GHG Protocol, ISO 14064, PCAF, CARB, Oregon, and Washington Ecology programs.

This position will report to the Associate Director, Climate and Verification Services

Compensation:$122,554 - $130,000

Duties and Responsibilities

Lead verification projects under CARB (California Air Resources Board), Washington Ecology, Oregon, The Climate Registry (TCR), and other GHG programs. Conduct regulatory risk assessments and design compliance roadmaps to prepare companies for disclosure requirements such as SB253, and SB261. Conduct greenhouse gas and environmental metrics accounting, produce life cycle assessments, integrate life-cycle data into Scope 3 inventories, and advance supplier engagement programs to improve data quality, track emissions, and support net-zero goals. Design corporate decarbonization strategies, such as scenario analyses, renewable energy procurement plans, climate risk analysis, and support ESG reporting aligned with various standards and frameworks. Present insights to executive stakeholders, lead client debriefs and meetings, and actively support business development through drafting proposals, delivering webinars, and engaging in client outreach. Lead internal audit within the verification body, with strong knowledge of American National Standards Institute (ANSI) standards and audit principles. Manage sustainability reporting, publish annual reports, agency ratings submissions and voluntary regulatory disclosures, ensuring alignment with global reporting frameworks like GRI, SASB, TCFD, SBTi, CDP, CSRD. Manage large project portfolios and develop project plans with clearly defined task assignments and schedules. Perform life cycle assessment (LCA), including performing modeling in software platforms such as LCA For Experts, calculating environmental impacts, and producing Environmental Product Declaration (EPD). Work with GHG programs, protocols, and regulations, including CARB; WA, TCR, WRI/WBCSD GHG Protocol, and USEPA mandatory GHG reporting rules. Oversee financial performance, invoicing, and profitability. Develop and maintain strategic client relationships, leading proposals, contracts, and negotiations. Identify opportunities for service innovation, process improvement, and practice area development. Develop templates, training materials, and process flows for the team. Supervise and coach junior staff and cross-functional teams, lead performance reviews. Represent the firm in industry events, conferences, and thought leadership activities. Telecommuting is available from anywhere in the US. HQ at 250 Commerce, Suite 210, Irvine, CA 92602.

Skills

This position requires a Master’s degree or equivalent in Civil and Environmental Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a related field. Two (2) years of related experience. Must be accredited as a lead verifier under an environmental regulatory program such as CARB Mandatory Reporting Program (MRR), Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS), Washington State Department of Ecology, or Oregon Department of Environmental Quality. Must also have experience with each of the following: 1) Experience in greenhouse gas accounting, life cycle assessment, or environmental metrics accounting; 2) Managing end-to-end sustainability reporting, including project management and publication of annual report, ratings agency submissions, and other voluntary or regulatory disclosures, ensuring alignment with global reporting standards and frameworks such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, SBTi, CDP, CSRD; 3) Leading verification projects under GHG programs such as CARB (California Air Resources Board), Washington Ecology, Oregon, or

The Climate Registry (TCR); 4) Leading internal audits within a verification body, with knowledge of American National Standards Institute (ANSI) standards and audit principles; 5) Experience in life cycle assessment (LCA), including performing modeling in software platforms such as LCA For Experts, calculating environmental impacts, and producing Environmental Product Declaration (EPD); 6) Experience working with GHG programs, protocols, and regulations. Will accept experience gained before, during or after Master’s program. Employer will accept experience gained concurrently. 10-20% domestic travel required to conduct seasonal site visits. Salary: $122,554 to $130,000/year. Full-time, position. Telecommuting is available from anywhere in the US. HQ at 250 Commerce, Suite 210, Irvine, CA 92602. Please apply online at

raw.description:
About Happy Health

Happy Health is revolutionizing sleep medicine delivery through our comprehensive telehealth platform. We've eliminated the traditional barriers to sleep care – no more waiting months for appointments or spending uncomfortable nights in sleep labs. Our patients receive FDA-cleared home sleep testing via Happy Ring, connect with board-certified sleep specialists, and when required, begin evidence-based treatment within just 5 days. Ongoing physiological data monitoring with the Happy Ring enables real-time condition management, combination therapies, and drives measurable outcomes.

Happy Ring represents the future of sleep diagnostics: an FDA-cleared medical device integrating advanced biometric sensors with AI-powered analysis to deliver highly accurate diagnostics and longitudinal management at home. For sleep medicine physicians, this means you'll have access to high-quality diagnostic data that empowers you to make confident clinical decisions for your patients, and integrate multimodal treatments that focus on root-cause solutions.

The Opportunity

Join a team of clinicians dedicated to expanding access to expert care across the country. As a Remote Physician, you'll deliver comprehensive, evidence-based telemedicine care for multiple sleep disorders including sleep-disordered breathing, insomnia, COMISA, restless legs syndrome, circadian rhythm disorders, and parasomnias. Our program begins with endotype/phenotype analyses, leading to tailored medical, psychological, dental, and device interventions that drive precision management, condition specific, and quality of life outcomes.

Location: Remote (work from anywhere in the U.S.)
Schedule: Flexible but consistent hours designed around patient availability and your lifestyle

Clinical Practice:

  • Perform comprehensive sleep medicine evaluations including detailed sleep histories, past medical histories, medications, family histories, etc…

  • Develop individualized, evidence-based treatment plans incorporating multi-modal PAP therapy, oral appliance therapy, CBTi, medications, etc…

  • Provide expert patient education based on the AASM clinical sleep healthcare guidelines, behavioral sleep medicine standards, and the latest in sleep and circadian clinical research

  • Work with a team of board-certified sleep colleagues, sleep-trained APRNs, and clinical researchers

  • Consult on complex cases and participate in clinical discussions, case conferences, and continuing education programming

  • Monitor longitudinal data and patient progress for treatment-emergent issues and evolving sleep pathologies

Professional Excellence:

  • Leverage our integrated EHR to maintain meticulous clinical documentation that exceeds current practice standards

  • Engage in quality improvement initiatives, evidence-based protocol development, and patient-reported outcomes measurements

  • Stay current with sleep medicine literature, clinical guidelines, and emerging therapeutics

Qualifications

  • Current, unrestricted US Medical license in 8+ states

  • Board certification in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Pulmonology, or Sleep Medicine

  • Must maintain residence in the United States

  • Multiple medical state licenses to practice, preferred

Technical Competency:

  • Prior telehealth experience strongly preferred

  • Comfortable with EHR systems, remote monitoring platforms, and sleep technology interfaces

  • Quick to adapt to new clinical tools and digital workflows

Happy Health is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.description:
Project Overview

The Province requires a Project Manager (PM) to provide project delivery oversight and coordination across multiple concurrent, high-priority initiatives currently in progress. The successful resource must be capable of managing multiple streams of work simultaneously, maintaining strong vendor and stakeholder relationships, and ensuring deliverables are advanced in accordance with project timelines, governance expectations, and operational objectives.

The PM's time will be split between two key streams of activities, although additional work activities may be required.

Cybersecurity (CYBER) Vulnerability Mitigation Program

The CYBER program requires a PM at 50% allocation to continue work on the Legacy Server Remediation Project. While measurable progress has been achieved, critical end-of-life infrastructure remain active, including SQL Server 2012 and Windows 2008/2012 servers. Windows 2016 servers will not be supported after January, 2027 and must also be remediated. These efforts are essential to reducing legacy risk exposure and require sustained governance and coordination with various technical areas and projects.

Delivery timelines remain at risk and the remediation effort is expected to extend well beyond September, with a significant volume of work remaining. Maintaining continuity in project leadership is therefore essential to ensure stable execution, effective risk management, and sustained delivery momentum.

This engagement will enable continued oversight, cross-subproject coordination, mitigation of delivery risks, and support the successful progression of the Legacy Server Remediation Project.

SharePoint Online (SPO) Migration Management

The SPO Migration Project has completed the majority of migrations; however, the remaining work represents the most complex and resource-intensive portion of the initiative. A dedicated PM is required to coordinate ministries, manage approvals, resolve ownership and migration issues, monitor delivery, and mitigate risks. This role is essential to ensuring successful completion of the project and preventing extended operational support costs associated with legacy SharePoint environments.

The PM is responsible for the overall management and support of critical in-flight and/or emerging work across SPO and infrastructure initiatives. Primary responsibilities include:

  • Manage and oversee the completion of remaining SP2016 migrations and decommissioning
  • Delivery of 5 outstanding intranets
  • Complete and manage the extranet migration, which includes the legacy server (2008) replacement
    • WFD Farm
    • Manage dependency on PEDs/SIAMS access
  • Manage the transition of 22 Power Apps built to replace SP2016 customizations to CCS operations

This work is time-sensitive and required to meet migration commitments and reduce legacy platform risk. SP2016 will be at end of life on July 14, 2026 and ongoing risk management with Cybersecurity is required.

The PM will provide continuity, utilize established knowledge and relationships, and experienced oversight across these interdependent workstreams. Without this resource, timelines will slip, security/operational risks will increase, and current capacity constraints will impact delivery.

Scope of Services

The PM will provide end-to-end project management services across multiple concurrent initiatives, including planning, coordination, business analysis, schedule management, stakeholder engagement, vendor oversight, procurement support, governance reporting, risk and issue management, and transition planning. The current scope of work includes initiatives listed above but may expand to include other initiatives as required.

Duties

Overall responsibility for coordinating and delivering IT projects from initiation through completion. This includes overseeing all project activities, establishing timelines, assigning tasks, and tracking progress to ensure objectives are met. Maintains effective working relationships with project teams, vendors, and cross‑departmental partners. Provides clear, timely progress updates and prepares status reports for senior management.

  • Compile project charters, business/project plans and other relevant project documentation in compliance with established project practices, standards and controls.
  • Manage project(s) that may include documenting business requirements, designing and delivering IT solutions that are compliant with and contribute to the Ministries' enterprise architecture.
  • Assist with the development of recommendations including providing details of resource requirements, dependencies, interdependencies, policy implications pertaining to internal/external influences and the methodology to be applied.
  • Produce and package deliverables for presentation to various internal support teams, steering committee, and other project stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple projects and resources, and utilize appropriate project governance and oversight
  • Work with Program Managers and project sponsors to ensure that effective project communication exists through the project(s) including escalation of risks as required.
  • Take responsibility for ongoing client satisfaction, manage peer-level client relationships and overcome hurdles to ensure win-win solutions.
  • Collaborate with business and IT leadership to develop a well-defined project plan that clearly states the project's objectives, scope, assumptions, timeline, resource requirements, risks, benefits and budget.
  • Work with program managers, project sponsors and Project Standards and Controls to ensure that project organizational structures have clearly defined roles and responsibilities for all stakeholders.
  • Document and report project status against established objectives, milestones, budget and resources and facilitate tracking and closure of issues and risks.
  • Develop project schedule plans and strategies, estimate resource requirements, develop and monitor work plans and take corrective action for completion of project tasks.
  • Provide guidance to project resources in establishing work priorities and prompt delivery of project tasks.
  • Develop, as required, related requirements documentation.
  • In collaboration with program managers and project sponsors, assess whether the project achieved stated outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement for future similar projects.
  • Provide leadership and assistance to business and project teams that require change management and communication support.
  • Work within the standards defined by Project Services (PS) and, in the absence of standards, work with PS to define new standards.
  • Leverage MS applications, collaboration tools, AI, and other relevant tools to enhance reporting and communications

WHAT TO EXPECT AS A WALDEN FACULTY MEMBER

Faculty members educate Walden University students by effectively and proficiently using online technology and resources so that knowledge, information, feedback, and critique are imparted to and shared with students in thoughtful, carefully formulated, well written, and timely communications. Faculty are required to grade assignments, participate in discussions, respond to student emails, use technology designed to enhance the learning experience for students. This is accomplished in an environment that is respectful of the student, the faculty member, Walden University, and the discipline in which the faculty member is involved.

TRAINING

All new faculty members receive specific training from Walden University in the techniques of online teaching; use of an electronic learning platform; specifics of the policies, procedures, and degree programs of the School or College in which they are going to teach; socialization into the Walden University culture; assessment of academic integrity of student work; and research supervision of theses and dissertations. Teaching and mentorship assignments are contingent upon successful completion of required training. During the first term of teaching, faculty members may be assigned a faculty peer mentor (senior colleague) as an extension of their new instructor training. Peer mentors will continue to support instruction and provide peer reviews of the classroom on a regular basis.

COURSE/ TEACHING AVAILABILITY

Faculty members are assigned courses, which are taught using Canvas, and are responsible for interacting with students within Canvas. Discussion Boards for classrooms are open 24 hrs/day, 7 days/wk. Faculty members are expected to be in the classroom a minimum of 4 days/wk and responses to student questions must be posted within 48 hrs. The university suggests regular and predictable availability, such as online office hours or regular online chats; office hours may be required based on program or college policy.

TOOLS/ TECHNICAL SKILLS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability

required. Incumbents will be evaluated, in part, based on performance of each essential function. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

LICENSING/ CERTIFICATION

Faculty Members must be appropriately credentialed, work currently as a FNP, possess an earned degree from an accredited institution or recognized by a country's ministry of education in the discipline being taught, and may be expected to be licensed or license-eligible in order to teach in specific programs. Faculty Members must maintain their licenses and any appropriate certifications in order to continue to teach at Walden University. Faculty Members are also expected to maintain currency with research by reviewing articles, journals, and presentations. If participating in research, the Faculty Member may publish and acknowledge Walden University.

All NP faculty are required to obtain and maintain RN and APRN licensure in the state of Minnesota and must provide evidence of current Advanced Practice certification prior to hire as Nurse Practitioner Faculty at Walden University. A multi-state compact RN license, as well as active RN and APRN licensure in Arizona, Washington, Nevada, Alaska, and Oklahoma, is preferred but not required. A multi-state compact RN license, as well as active RN and APRN licensure in Arizona, Washington, Nevada, Alaska, and Oklahoma, is preferred but not required. This position may be eligible for bonus upon hire.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE

  • Earned Doctorate (DNP or PhD) preferred.
  • A record of professional scholarly contributions to their field of specialization.
  • A minimum of one year’s experience of teaching in higher education.
  • Current clinical experience in NP practice.
  • A minimum 2 years' experience as a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) in primary care preferred.
  • Teaching experience, preferred online teaching experience, but not required
  • Commitment to advocating for the learning and development needs of students earning their degrees in a distance learning environment.
  • Excellent oral and written communication, leadership, team, collaboration and interpersonal skills.
  • Board Certified Family Nurse Practitioner

TRAVEL

Contributing faculty members may have the opportunity to travel to university events and residencies. When traveling to these events, the faculty member will be expected to fully participate in the event. For core faculty, there will be required travel throughout the year. WORK ENVIRONMENT Work is performed primarily in a standard office environment but may involve exposure to moderate noise levels. Work involves operation of personal computer equipment for 6–8 hours daily and

includes physical demands associated with a traditional office setting (e.g., walking, standing, communicating, and other physical functions as necessary).

TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS

Faculty members are expected to have a personal computer with virus protection and Internet access. Walden University provides a Walden e-mail account and access to the learning platform, password-protected faculty sections of the website, university and college listservs, and other faculty communications tools. Software Requirements include current Web browser (Internet Explorer ver. 9.0 or higher or Firefox ver. 19 or higher); Microsoft Office suite; Adobe Reader; Adobe Flash Player; Apple QuickTime; Windows Media Player; antivirus software (e.g., McAfee or Norton) installed, running, and kept current by promptly installing the upgrades and patches made available by the software manufacturer. Software versions are subject to change

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is as follows:

  • Graduate Course Instruction: $1,560 - $4,080 per Quarter or Semester, depending on type of course taught and length of course
  • Undergraduate Course Instruction: $700 - $2,200 per quarter, depending on type of course taught and length of course

    Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Walden also offers other opportunities for its contributing faculty members, such as dissertation/doctoral study committee chair positions, research reviewing, and dissertation and doctoral study mentoring.

    Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

About Walden University

Walden University is a member of Adtalem Global Education (NYSE: ATGE). More than 50 years ago, Walden University was founded to support adult learners in achieving their academic goals and making a greater impact in their professions and communities. Students from across the U.S. and more than 115 countries are pursuing a certificate, bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree online at Walden. The university offers more than 100 online degree and certificate programs. Walden University is accredited by The Higher Learning Commission, hlcommission.org. For more information, please visit WaldenU.edu and WaldenFacts.com.

Visit WaldenU.edu for more information, and follow on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn.

raw.excerpt: About Misfits Market:Misfits Market is a mission-driven, high-growth startup dedicated to reducing food waste and making shopping for sustainable, high-quality groceries easier and more affordable.
raw.description:
About Misfits Market:

Misfits Market is a mission-driven, high-growth startup dedicated to reducing food waste and making shopping for sustainable, high-quality groceries easier and more affordable. We deliver organic produce, high-quality meats and seafood, plant-based proteins, dairy, bakery, wine, and other grocery items to nearly every zip code in 48 states at up to 30 percent off traditional grocery store prices. In 2022, Misfits Market acquired sustainable e-grocer Imperfect Foods and now leverages its in-house transportation network to deliver directly to consumers with one of the most carbon-efficient grocery delivery models on the market. By tackling inefficiencies in the food system, our passionate and motivated team of problem solvers helps save an average of 500,000 pounds of food per week from waste or lesser outcomes, with an all-time savings of 190+ million pounds of food.

As Misfits we support our customers and mission by embracing our core values of:

Prioritizing our Customers

Doing more with less

Thinking Differently

Respecting one another

Moving deliberately and quickly

Taking initiative and delivering

About the team:

The Data Analytics team is a pivotal part of the organization, closely collaborating with major stakeholders across the company including Product, Finance, Operations, Growth Marketing, Merchandising, and Logistics. Our primary goal is to craft insightful reporting on key metrics, empowering immediate and impactful actions. We are recognized as trusted advisors, having a significant voice in guiding the strategic direction of these departments.

As a team, we foster both specialization and generalization. Each team member serves as a point of contact for a specific department, ensuring tailored support and expertise. Simultaneously, we emphasize a broad understanding of all departments we work with. This ensures a cohesive, supportive environment where knowledge is shared, and support and collaboration is common.

About the role:

As a Senior Data Analyst, Experimentation at Misfits Market, you’ll serve as the company’s go-to expert on experimental design and causal inference, while remaining hands-on with stakeholder dashboarding needs. You’ll help evolve our experimentation culture by designing and evaluating controlled experiments, developing models to improve and simplify dashboard development, and mentor analysts on designing experiments and interpreting results.

Responsibilities:

  • Own experimentation analytics. Design, monitor and interpret A/B and multivariate tests across Product and Marketing
  • Partner with Product Managers and Marketing leads to prioritize experiments using frameworks like ICE or PIE
  • Translate experimental results into business recommendations
  • Collaborate with engineering to ensure consistent event tracking and instrumentation design
  • Develop internal experimentation frameworks. Build dbt models and dashboards that automate experiment tracking, power statistical analyses, and improve interpretability.
  • Mentor analysts: guide the team in best practices for causal inference, power analysis, metric selection, and communicating uncertainty.
  • Improve data infrastructure: maintain and improve dbt models, metrics definitions, and self-serve data assets.
  • Develop descriptive reporting dashboards across Product, Merchandising, and other teams
  • Dive into complex SQL and break down problems
  • Identify areas of opportunity to move from descriptive to predictive analytics, and ad-hoc to self-serve reporting
  • Maintain analytics roadmap to prioritize initiatives, communicate timelines, and ensure successful, timely completion of deliverables

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field with 3+ years of relevant experience, or Bachelor’s degree in the same fields with 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Expert-level SQL skills - you are comfortable writing complex queries and optimizing for performance
  • Deep understanding of experiment design, causal inference, and statistical testing
  • Experience with dbt and data modeling best practices
  • Proficiency with Python or R for statistical analysis
  • Experience with visualization tools, such as Mode, Tableau, PowerBI, etc
  • Experience with data pipelines - have created and/or are comfortable communicating ETL needs to engineering
  • Strong communication skills - you can gather user stories and translate data insights to stakeholders of varying levels of technical knowledge
  • Experience working as part of a cross-functional data team

Preferred / Nice to have:

  • Prior experience in e-commerce or lifecycle marketing

Details of Position & Benefits:

  • Salary range $120,000 - $135,000
  • Full-time exempt position
  • 100 % Remote Work
  • Salary and employee stock options commensurate with experience
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Multiple health, dental, and vision plan options
  • Life Insurance
  • 401K plan
