raw.description:
lust auf neue herausforderungen?

Du kennst TYPO3 in- und auswendig, fühlst dich auch in WordPress zu Hause und siehst sofort, wenn auf dem Smartphone ein Button verrutscht? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Als Freelance Webentwickler (m/w/d) bei zahneins, dem führenden Partner für Zahnärzt*innen in Deutschland, sorgst du dafür, dass die Websites unserer Praxen sowie unsere eigene reibungslos funktionieren und gut aussehen. Du baust nach Auftrag Landingpages für Kampagnen, bindest Buchungstools und Schnittstellen an und behebst Fehler, bevor sie jemandem auffallen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, wie Patientinnen und Patienten an über 80 Standorten ihren Termin buchen und wie Fachkräfte den Weg in unsere Teams finden.

perspektiven:

  • Vollständig remote: Arbeite, von wo du willst
  • Flexible Zeiten: Du teilst dir deine Arbeit selbst ein, solange Tickets zuverlässig und zeitnah bearbeitet werden
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit: Wir suchen keine Einmal-Lösung, sondern einen festen technischen Partner mit regelmäßiger Auslastung
  • Vielfalt statt Routine: Über 80 Praxis-Websites mit eigenen Identitäten, Kampagnen-Landingpages und Integrationen
  • Klare Tickets und kurze Wege: Anfragen laufen strukturiert über E-Mail bzw. unser Ticketsystem, Rückfragen klärst du direkt mit dem Team
  • Starkes Umfeld: Du arbeitest mit unserem SEO-Spezialisten, unserer Art Direction und einem wertschätzenden Marketing-Team zusammen
  • Moderner Stack: Composer-basiertes TYPO3 mit Content Blocks, lokale Docker-Umgebungen und ein gepflegtes Sitepackage mit zentralem SCSS und wiederverwendbaren Komponenten. Alles liegt versioniert in Git, pro Ticket gibt es einen eigenen Branch mit Merge Request und Review vor dem Livegang.
  • Raum für Ideen: Wenn du Wege siehst, Abläufe zu automatisieren oder Seiten besser zu machen, hören wir zu

aufgaben:

  • Umsetzung von Tickets aus dem Marketing-Team: Anpassungen an Inhalten, Buttons, Links und Layouts
  • Entwicklung von Landingpages, Pop-ups und Störern, nach Designvorlage oder mit eigenem gestalterischen Gespür
  • Integration von Drittanbieter-Diensten wie Online-Terminbuchung, Social-Media-Feeds oder Formularen
  • Aufspüren und Beheben von Darstellungsfehlern auf Desktop und Mobil
  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer WordPress-Seiten, unter anderem für den zahneins Campus
  • Perspektivisch und nach Absprache: Updates, Extension-Pflege und Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unseres TYPO3-Systems
Technisches SEO, strukturierte Daten und Tracking verantwortet unser SEO-Spezialist. Bei Änderungen mit Auswirkungen auf Rankings, URLs oder das Tracking stimmst du dich mit ihm ab. So kannst du dich voll auf eine saubere technische Umsetzung konzentrieren.

profil:

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Schrift: Deutsch muss nicht deine Muttersprache sein. Wichtig ist, dass du unsere Tickets und Anforderungen sicher verstehst, gerne auch mit Unterstützung von Übersetzungstools.
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der TYPO3-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit TYPO3 12/13, Fluid, TypoScript und Content Blocks
  • Erfahrung mit TYPO3-Multisite-Installationen und Site Configurations
  • Sicherer Umgang mit PHP 8.x, HTML5, CSS/SCSS und JavaScript
  • Erfahrung in der Anbindung externer Dienste und Schnittstellen (z. B. Buchungs-Widgets, XML/JSON-Feeds, REST-APIs)
  • Solide WordPress-Kenntnisse, inklusive Theme-Anpassungen und Plugin-Entwicklung
  • Mobile-first-Denken und sauberes Responsive Design
  • Gespür für Webdesign: Du setzt Layouts aus Figma oder PDF präzise um und findest auch ohne detaillierte Vorlage eine visuell stimmige Lösung
  • Ein Auge für Details: Du bemerkst Anzeigefehler, bevor sie gemeldet werden, und testest auf verschiedenen Geräten und Browsern
  • Saubere Einbindung: Du schreibst semantisches HTML mit klarer Überschriftenstruktur, Alt-Texten und aussagekräftigen Linktexten und bindest externe Widgets consent-konform und asynchron ein, ohne dass das Layout springt.
  • Workflow: Sicherer Umgang mit Git (Branches, Merge Requests), Composer und Docker-basierten Entwicklungsumgebungen
  • Performance als Handwerkszeug: Du prüfst deine Umsetzung mit Lighthouse bzw. PageSpeed, kennst die Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) und lieferst Bilder responsiv in modernen Formaten aus (srcset, WebP/AVIF, gezieltes Lazy Loading).
  • Qualitätsbewusstsein: Für dich gehört zu einer guten Umsetzung, dass sie schlank, performant und langfristig wartbar ist. Du baust auf vorhandenen Komponenten auf, orientierst dich an PSR-12 und den TYPO3 Coding Guidelines und setzt Inhalte so um, dass die Redaktion sie selbst pflegen kann.
  • Zuverlässigkeit: Du reagierst auf neue Tickets innerhalb eines Werktags und gibst transparent Rückmeldung, auch wenn eine Lösung etwas länger dauert. Kritische Fehler, etwa eine ausgefallene Online-Terminbuchung, packst du möglichst noch am selben Tag an

neugierig geworden?

Interessiert? Dann melde dich gerne direkt bei uns mit einer kurzen Vorstellung, Referenzen oder Links zu TYPO3-Projekten, an denen du mitgearbeitet hast, deiner Stundensatzvorstellung und deiner verfügbaren Kapazität pro Woche. Zeig uns gern ein Projekt, auf dessen Umsetzung und Performance du besonders stolz bist. Lass uns gemeinsam herausfinden, wie wir am besten zusammenarbeiten können!

Bei Fragen steht dir gerne Marie Asbrand zur Verfügung: 0151 17595887

über uns

Wir sind zahneins, der führende Dentalverbund in Deutschland mit über 80 Standorten und mehr als 2.400 Mitarbeitenden. Seit unserer Gründung 2016 setzen wir auf Innovation, Qualität und partnerschaftliches Miteinander. Unsere Werte Teamstärke, Leidenschaft, Qualitätsstreben, Innovation und Integrität sind dabei nicht nur Buzzwords, sondern der Kern unserer Kultur.

raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Power BI / Microsoft Fabric Developer to design and build end-to-end analytics solutions supporting our supply chain and manufacturing operations. You will work closely with business stakeholders to transform data from SAP ERP and other systems into dashboards and semantic models that drive better decisions.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and Fabric solutions with a focus on performance, usability, and storytelling.
  • Translate supply chain and manufacturing requirements into data models and visualizations such as inventory, production, procurement, logistics, OEE, OTIF, lead times, and supplier performance.
  • Ingest and transform data from SAP ERP and other systems into curated data marts and datasets using SQL, Power Query, and Fabric or Azure data services.
  • Write and optimize SQL, DAX, and where relevant MDX queries, including performance tuning and debugging.
  • Implement and maintain ETL and ELT processes to ensure timely and high-quality data delivery.
  • Work with supply chain, manufacturing, and finance stakeholders to understand processes and KPIs, refine requirements, and improve dashboards.
  • Apply BI best practices for data modeling, semantic layer design, row-level security, usability, and governance.
  • Integrate data from APIs and web services to enrich datasets and automate refreshes.
  • Document solutions and provide handover and training when needed.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience developing reports and dashboards with Microsoft Power BI and the Microsoft data stack.
  • Strong ability to write complex SQL, DAX, and optionally MDX queries.
  • Experience with query optimization and performance troubleshooting.
  • Proven experience building interactive dashboards and impactful visualizations.
  • Solid experience in data analysis, data modeling, and data mart design.
  • Understanding of data warehousing concepts and analytical architectures.
  • Practical experience with SAP ERP data in a supply chain or manufacturing context, ideally including MM, SD, and PP.
  • Working knowledge of ETL tools and technologies such as Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Informatica, DataStage, Talend, or similar.
  • Experience with Azure data services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, Azure Blob or ADLS storage, or Fabric lake houses and pipelines.
  • Experience integrating data from APIs and web services.

Language(s) :

  • Spanish native
  • English fluent

raw.excerpt: Hello!  ✨We’re Wildix, a global leader in Unified Communications & Collaboration as a Service (UCaaS) and we’re on a mission to redefine how businesses connect.
raw.description:
Hello! ✨

We’re Wildix, a global leader in Unified Communications & Collaboration as a Service (UCaaS) and we’re on a mission to redefine how businesses connect. Our secure, web-based and AI-powered solutions help companies around the world collaborate smarter, serve customers better and grow stronger — and we want you to help shape what’s next.

About Us…

In 2005, brothers Dimitri and Steve Osler set out to reimagine how businesses communicate, and that vision became Wildix. Today, from our headquarters in Tallinn, Estonia, Wildix is one of the world’s fastest-growing UCaaS companies, with 300+ team members from 15+ nationalities, working across Europe, the UK, the Americas and beyond. We serve businesses in 135+ countries through a partner-first ecosystem, delivering secure, intuitive solutions that keep companies connected, productive and ready for what’s next.

At Wildix, we don’t just build technology, we live it. As a remote-first company, we rely on our own platform every day to collaborate globally and innovate fast. With steady growth and a strong foundation, we offer real opportunities to advance your career as we scale, making an impact in a global team that’s shaping the future of work.

At Wildix, our mission is clear: Empower companies worldwide with seamless communication solutions that drive productivity, efficiency, and growth.

About The Role

We're building the AI layer of business communication — voice agents, chat agents and AI assistants that work in real customer conversations and real phone calls across 135+ countries.

You'll join our AI Agents stream, an 8-person engineering team owning the product end to end. You'll build the agents themselves as well as the platform behind them: skills, workflows, tools, connectors, orchestration, observability and the infrastructure that makes AI reliable, fast and measurable in production.

This is a hands-on product engineering role for someone who wants to build real AI products, not just integrate AI APIs.

What You Will Do

  • Build and ship AI agent features end to end — from Node.js/TypeScript services on AWS to the interfaces used to configure, test and observe agents.
  • Extend the AI agent platform — building skills, workflows, sandboxes, tools, connectors, tracing, audit and orchestration capabilities.
  • Integrate and orchestrate AI providers — LLM, STT and TTS — using prompt and context engineering, tool calling, structured outputs, streaming and robust failure handling.
  • Make AI quality measurable and production-ready — build evaluations, tracing and monitoring while engineering for latency, reliability, cost, privacy and security.
  • Drive product discovery and ownership — challenge scope, propose solutions, bring your own ideas and stay involved after release by using quality and adoption signals to iterate.
  • Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, architecture decisions, knowledge sharing and collaboration across the AI Agents stream.

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js backend skills and confidence working across the frontend with React or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered features used by real users in production. You should be able to explain what you built, how it worked and the engineering decisions behind it.
  • Practical experience with AI application patterns including prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, RAG, streaming and handling non-deterministic behaviour in production.
  • Experience making AI systems measurable and observable through evaluations, tracing, monitoring and regression detection.
  • Strong production AWS experience with serverless and/or containerized environments. Our stack includes Lambda/SAM, ECS, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS and OpenSearch.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals across REST/API design, WebSockets, SQL and NoSQL data modelling, caching, testing, CI/CD and production debugging.
  • A strong ownership and product mindset — you take initiative, challenge assumptions, work comfortably with ambiguity and turn ideas into shipped features rather than waiting for detailed specifications.
  • English B2 or above.

Bonus Points If

  • You've built agentic systems involving multi-step orchestration, tool selection, state management, guardrails or recovery from failures.
  • You've worked in security- or privacy-sensitive environments, including GDPR or ISO 27001.
  • You have public evidence of building for the sake of building — open-source contributions, side projects, technical writing, talks or similar.
  • You have experience with real-time audio and communication technologies, such as WebRTC, streaming STT/TTS or low-latency voice pipelines.

Why You’ll Love It Here

👫 Work with a Supportive, High-Performing Team – We believe in trust, autonomy, and working with bright, passionate individuals who drive real impact.

raw.description:
NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars.

Come work for the team that brought to you NCCL, NVSHMEM & GPUDirect. Our GPU communication libraries are crucial for scaling Deep Learning and HPC applications! We are looking for a motivated Performance engineer to influence the roadmap of our communication libraries. The DL and HPC applications of today have a huge compute demand and run on scales which go up to tens of thousands of GPUs. The GPUs are connected with high-speed interconnects (eg. NVLink, PCIe) within a node and with high-speed networking (eg. Infiniband, Ethernet) across the nodes. Communication performance between the GPUs has a direct impact on the end-to-end application performance; and the stakes are even higher at huge scales! This is an outstanding opportunity for someone with HPC and performance background to advance the state of the art in this space. Are you ready for to contribute to the development of innovative technologies and help realize NVIDIA's vision?

What you will be doing:

  • Conduct in-depth performance characterization and analysis on large multi-GPU and multi-node clusters.

  • Study the interaction of our libraries with all HW (GPU, CPU, Networking) and SW components in the stack

  • Evaluate proof-of-concepts, conduct trade-off analysis when multiple solutions are available

  • Triage and root-cause performance issues reported by our customers

  • Collect a lot of performance data; build tools and infrastructure to visualize and analyze the information

  • Collaborate with a very dynamic team across multiple time zones

What we need to see:

  • M.S. (or equivalent experience) or PHD in Computer Science, or related field with relevant performance engineering and HPC experience

  • 3+ yrs of experience with parallel programming and at least one communication runtime (MPI, NCCL, UCX, NVSHMEM)

  • Experience conducting performance benchmarking and triage on large scale HPC clusters

  • Good understanding of computer system architecture, HW-SW interactions and operating systems principles (aka systems software fundamentals)

  • Implement micro-benchmarks in C/C++, read and modify the code base when required

  • Ability to debug performance issues across the entire HW/SW stack. Proficient in a scripting language, preferably Python

  • Familiar with containers, cloud provisioning and scheduling tools (Kubernetes, SLURM, Ansible, Docker)

  • Adaptability and passion to learn new areas and tools. Flexibility to work and communicate effectively across different teams and timezones

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Practical experience with Infiniband/Ethernet networks in areas like RDMA, topologies, congestion control

  • Experience debugging network issues in large scale deployments

  • Familiarity with CUDA programming and/or GPUs

  • Experience with Deep Learning Frameworks such PyTorch, TensorFlow

NVIDIA is at the forefront of breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our teams are composed of driven, innovative professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We offer highly competitive salaries, an extensive benefits package, and a work environment that promotes diversity, inclusion, and flexibility. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a supportive and empowering workplace for all.

raw.description:
About Us!

Raptor was founded in 2002 with the mission to protect every child, every school, every day. Today, Raptor is a school safety partner for 60,000 schools in 55 countries, providing SaaS and mobile technology as well as comprehensive training and consultation solutions across the entire school safety life cycle, ranging from crisis prevention and preparation to emergency response and recovery. Raptor’s globally integrated product portfolio supports a school’s foundation of safety and wellbeing, including Emergency Management, Campus Movement, Student Wellbeing and Safety Training and Compliance.

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Sales Operations Coordinator to join our team. This role focuses on building accurate quotes in Salesforce CPQ and collaborating cross-functionally with Contracts, Legal, and Finance to ensure smooth deal handoffs. We welcome candidates with strong analytics, documentation, and process-optimization experience who can quickly ramp in CPQ—extensive tenured CPQ background is not required.

This is a 4 month temporary, full time position (40 hours/week).There is potential for an assignment extension, which will be discussed towards the end of the engagement.

Responsibilities

  • Quote Creation & Delivery
    • Configure Salesforce CPQ quotes from Sales inputs (products, quantities, term lengths), ensuring line-item subscription ARR is correctly calculated.
    • Apply standard discount rules based on established rate cards; flag any nonstandard discount requests for approval.
    • Generate and distribute final quote documents (PDF/Word) to Sales reps within the agreed SLA (typically < 24 business hours).
  • Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Liaise with Contracts to confirm that all standard SLAs, T&Cs, and contract language are reflected in each quote as needed.
    • Work with Legal on any special contract language or exceptions, documenting and routing those items promptly as required.
    • Partner with Finance to validate billing frequencies, subscription tiers, and revenue details before quote issuance on demand.
  • Quote Validation & Process Compliance
    • Conduct detailed reviews of each quote for completeness—verifying product configurations, term selections, and discount accuracy.
    • Document any manual adjustments or exceptions (e.g., custom discount reasons) in Salesforce.
  • Documentation & Process Improvement
    • Author clear, step-by-step operating procedures for CPQ processes, drawing on experience with SOPs and process optimization.
    • Maintain version control of quote templates and CPQ configuration guides, ensuring the latest standards are always in use.
    • Identify recurring pain points or process gaps; recommend and help implement small enhancements (e.g., field-level help text in CPQ) to reduce quote errors and accelerate turnaround.
  • Sales Support & Communication
    • Serve as a primary CPQ resource for Sales reps—answering questions about bundling rules, term options, and standard discount guidelines.
    • Provide timely status updates on quote progress, including approvals pending with Contracts, Legal, or Finance.
    • Escalate critical issues (e.g., missing approvals, pricing mismatches) proactively to Sales Operations leadership.

Qualifications (Required):

  • Familiarity with Salesforce Revenue Cloud and/or Salesforce CPQ
  • Experience with Gong
  • Proven ability to partner seamlessly with Contracts, Legal, Finance (or comparable teams) to resolve process questions and ensure all stakeholders are aligned.
  • Demonstrated track record of authoring standard operating procedures and streamlining workflows—ideally reducing cycle times (e.g., as seen with material-creation optimizations).
  • Strong data-analysis aptitude (e.g., using Excel, Power BI) and high attention to detail, ensuring ≥ 98 % quote-accuracy rates.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication—capable of drafting playbook updates, conveying status to Sales reps, and coordinating multi-department handoffs.
  • Self-starter who can juggle multiple concurrent quote requests, prioritize by deal size or close date, and ask clarifying questions when needed.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Comfortable with ARR concepts, contract terms (annual vs. multi-year), and basic billing configurations—able to translate Sales requirements into CPQ‐compatible specs.
  • Experience leveraging Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies to reduce process cycle times (e.g., 80 % cycle time reduction on legacy systems).
  • Familiarity with building dashboards (Power BI or Excel pivot tables) to track process KPIs—such as quote turnaround or error rates.
  • Experience working in NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar ERP environments—understanding data accuracy and integrity across cross-functional systems.
  • Prior exposure to K-12 or higher-ed SaaS subscription dynamics, including funding cycles and seasonality.

What's in it for you?

  • You join the gold standard in school safety software.
  • You will join a company where innovation and customer collaboration are part of what drives new product development to help keep kids safe.
  • You will work with diverse teams made up of some of the best minds in the industry.
  • You will get exposure to strong mentorship and leadership that have supported a long history of career advancement opportunities for our employees.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to personally respond to every applicant or provide individual feedback. Candidates selected to move forward will be contacted directly by our team. We appreciate your interest in Raptor Technologies.

If you are a resident of California, Colorado, New Jersey, New York or Washington, please reach out to for a reasonable estimate of annual base compensation and any eligible incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered to successful candidates for roles may be higher or lower, based on non-discriminatory criteria including but not limited to relevant professional experience, geographic location, knowledge, skills, and abilities. This range will be reviewed on a regular basis.

Raptor Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, compensation, training, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, and termination.

raw.description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

Location Preference: Remote (US preferred, ET and CT timezones ideal)

About The Role:

As a Associate Marketing Manager at Fingerprint, you'll own the execution of our event and webinar campaigns from start to finish — building the emails, landing pages, and campaign assets that bring our strategy to life. You'll work in close, day-to-day partnership with our Performance Marketing Manager, who sets strategic direction and provides execution guidance, while also collaborating cross-functionally with Demand Generation, Field Marketing, Design, Sales, and Operations to launch campaigns that run smoothly, stay on schedule, and deliver a great experience for prospects and customers.

You'll be responsible for managing webinar logistics, coordinating campaign timelines, and ensuring every campaign is executed with attention to detail — from QA to reporting on performance. This role is ideal for someone who's organized, enjoys owning projects, and is eager to grow their execution skills in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end execution of webinar and event marketing campaigns
  • Build, QA, and launch emails, landing pages, forms, and workflows in HubSpot
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and keep stakeholders aligned on deliverables and deadlines
  • Manage webinar logistics, including registration pages, reminder emails, attendee communications, and post-event follow-up
  • Build and launch supporting campaigns across email and paid channels
  • Partner with Design and Content teams to ensure campaign assets are delivered on schedule
  • Partner with the BDR team to align event follow-up, lead activation, and post-event outreach
  • Build pre-event target lists and audience segments to support campaign execution
  • Own campaign reporting and performance analysis, maintaining accurate data in HubSpot and Salesforce while turning insights into recommendations for optimization.
  • Own campaign QA before launch to ensure emails, landing pages, forms, and workflows are working as expected
  • Support campaign optimization by testing new ideas and identifying opportunities to improve event performance.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in B2B campaign marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or a similar marketing role
  • Experience building emails, landing pages, forms, and workflows in HubSpot
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and how marketing campaigns are managed in a CRM
  • You have a test-and-learn mindset—you never settle for "good enough" and are constantly experimenting with new tactics, channels, and messaging to improve results.
  • Some experience supporting paid digital campaigns (LinkedIn, Meta, or similar platforms)
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and consistently meet deadlines
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal day-to-day direction
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proactive, resourceful, and eager to learn
  • Role requires proficiency with macOS and comfort working fully remotely using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom Webinar, and Asana

Compensation & Transparency

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $59,000 - $80,000.

Some example salaries for specific locations are below:

New York City: $70,000 - $80,000

Chicago: $59,000 - $68,000

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.

If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here.

If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here.

**We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Fingerprint recruiting email communications will always come from the @fingerprint.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Fingerprint via other sources should be ignored.

Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Solutions Consultant to join our team at Caseware, a leading SaaS organization. As a Solutions Consultant, you will play a critical role in ensuring our largest strategic customers are successful in their evaluations and implementations of Caseware solutions. In this role, you will strategise with customers on their goals, evaluations and implementations, understand their ongoing needs, design and maintain project plans, address customers’ questions pulling in SME’s, and provide consultative support across all aspects of a customer’s evaluation and implementation process. You will also liaise with team members in sales, account management, training ,support and product, as well as with our strategic partners, to help ensure key customer needs are addressed ona timely basis, and professionally.
You will work closely with in international teams to assist and contribute ideas in moving toward a global process within the solutions consulting team.
📍 Location:
The role is a remote role and is available to all applicants residing and eligible to work in the UK. There may be requirements to travel to various offices around the UK or internationally depending on client needs.
Dana Liulica - Talent Acquisition Partner

What you will be doing:

  • Partner with our Strategic Account Managers in helping our prospects and customers evaluate and implement Caseware products.
  • Strategize with customers on their evaluation & implementation journeys, identifying needs (e.g. communications, change management, training, champion and support strategy etc.) and working with them to develop a project plan to ensure key requirements are addressed.
  • Create and maintain product demo strategies and related assets that are value and benefit-driven, not feature walk throughs.
  • Support customer evaluations and implementations, providing information on tools, processes and resources to customers, and helping to ensure timelines and tasks remain on track.
  • Assist in the development and execution of customer migration strategies from their existing accounting and audit platforms to Caseware’s suite of cloud solutions.
  • Coordinate internally to address customer issues not handled through existing support channels (e.g. coordination of access, licenses, account maintenance, escalating support).
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of a product knowledge base for team members to access as a supplemental resource to the SC team.
  • Capture, and where appropriate respond to, customer and prospect feedback relating to product and sales experience to support continued innovation.
  • Create and maintain toolkits and resources to support customer evaluations and implementations, working with other Caseware teams as relevant.
  • Design and implementation of processes and systems to support the delivery of consistent, scalable services. Assist in the development and execution of improvement plans internally that are scalable to support future growth.
  • Attend key industry trade shows and events.
  • Participate in speaking engagements and thought leadership events as comfortable.

What you will bring:

  • At least 4 years’ experience working in an Audit/Accounting/Professional Services Firm performing External Audit or Assurance engagement or at least 5 years’ experience in customer facing role (e.g. customer success, account management, implementation, product or project management) in a SAAS company serving the Accounting Profession.
  • Excellent written, oral communication and presentation skills.
  • Effective communicator with ability to understand and interpret stakeholder needs.
  • Strong organization skills with experience tracking and managing multiple deliverables and tasks.
  • A resourceful self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment where initiative and problem-solving skills are required.
  • Have a sound understanding of technology within the audit and accountancy sector, or an enthusiasm to learn.
  • Nice to have: Chartered Accountant (or equivalent) with 5+ years of external audit experience, ideally with hands-on use of CaseWare; background in audit innovation, training, or tech adoption within a firm; strong understanding of financial processes, project/product management, CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce), and experience collaborating with product, marketing, or sales teams.

What's in it for you:

▪️Innovation is at our core. We work with cutting-edge technology in accounting and financial reporting, constantly pushing the boundaries to create impactful software solutions.
▪️We are committed to a collaborative culture, where your ideas are valued, and knowledge sharing is encouraged within a supportive, inclusive team.
▪️Work-life balance is important to us. We offer flexible work options, remote opportunities, and generous time-off policies to ensure a healthy work-life balance.
▪️We offer competitive compensation, including a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits
▪️We are driven by impactful work. Your contributions directly affect how our clients manage financial processes and drive their success.
▪️Recognition and rewards matter to us. We celebrate hard work through recognition programs, performance bonuses, and opportunities for career growth.
▪️We embrace global opportunities. Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team.

About Caseware:

Caseware's cutting-edge software products are meticulously designed for accounting firms, corporations, and governments. Our teams are continually collaborating, innovating, and building upon our existing suite of products. With a customer-focused mindset, we are building technology that is shaping what the future of audits, financial reporting, and financial data analytics will look like.
With a recent strategic investment from Hg Capital in 2020, Caseware is now in its next major growth phase as we double down on the people and products that have made Caseware so successful to date.
One of Caseware's core values is Many Voices, One Team and with that in mind, we're dedicated to building teams as diverse as our customers in an equitable and inclusive way. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Should you require accommodations or have any questions at any point during the application or interview process, please e-mail our People Operations team at .

Background Check:

Any candidates successful in obtaining an offer for a position will need to successfully complete a background check through Certn.co which typically includes an Identity Verification and Criminal Record Check. Executives and Senior Managers will undergo a Soft Credit Check as well. Candidates residing in the Netherlands and Germany are excluded from undergoing background checks via Certn.co

By 2026, we’re aiming to achieve $500 million in revenue and operate over 50 thriving online stores worldwide.

With a team of 160+ top-tier remote e-commerce professionals across the globe, we blend local brand experiences with cross-border logistics, ensuring every customer feels connected—no matter where they are.

At our core, we value hard work, freedom with responsibility, constant improvement, and a mindset of positivity. We believe in building a high-performance, remote-first culture where honesty, excellence, and creativity drive everything we do—because the future of work is global, and we’re building it together.

The Upsides of Working with Us

💪 Hard Work That Matters

We’re surrounded by people who care deeply and give their best. We don’t settle for average—we show up, push boundaries, and aim high. That shared drive creates momentum and meaning in everything we do.

🔓 Freedom with Responsibility

You have the freedom to choose how, when, and where you work—but freedom only thrives when it’s paired with ownership. We trust you to manage your time, meet your commitments, and take responsibility for your impact.

📚 Constant Improvement

Growth is part of our DNA. We believe in learning, evolving, and getting 1% better every day. Whether it’s a new skill, a fresh mindset, or sharper execution—stagnation isn’t in our vocabulary.

🌞 Positivity by Default

We approach people, problems, and communication with a positive mindset. That means giving the benefit of the doubt, staying constructive, and keeping energy high—even when challenges arise.

🗣️ Honesty & Transparency

We believe the fastest way to move forward is through clear, honest communication. No politics. No guessing games. Just straight talk that builds trust and strengthens our team.

🏆 Excellence Is the Baseline

We hold ourselves and each other to a high standard—not out of pressure, but out of pride. We care too much about what we’re building to accept "good enough." Excellence is the expectation.

🎯 Creativity Welcome Here

We encourage bold ideas, fast testing, and open collaboration. Failure doesn’t scare us—comfort does. That’s why creativity is valued as a core ingredient in everything from product to process.

We’re on the lookout for a Supply Chain Project Lead to take charge of critical initiatives that shape the future of our operations.

The Challenge

As we take on more complex initiatives across our supply chain, we’re facing a gap in project leadership — we need strong, strategic minds who can not only plan but also drive execution to results. You'll be stepping in to lead high-impact projects from strategy to implementation, ensuring we’re resourced properly, aligned on priorities, and seeing real progress. If you’re someone who thrives on turning ideas into action and keeping cross-functional teams moving, this role is for you.

Early Success Milestones for this role

  • Able to understand the ins and outs of the supply chain operations
  • Deliver results by leading 1-2 Kaizen projects

Your Team When You Join Us

You’ll be part of our Supply Chain Team, made up of 28 team members, all reporting directly to our Supply Chain Manager based in China. You will also lead 2 direct reports. It’s a fast-paced, collaborative team focused on driving operational excellence across our global e-commerce operations.

We would love to hear from you if…

  • You have 5–10 years of experience in supply chain or logistics, ideally within cross-border e-commerce operations.
  • You've worked in a top-tier e-commerce company (e.g. Alibaba Level 5+, TikTok Level 2-1+)and understand how high-performing supply chain teams operate at scale.
  • Shopify experience is a big plus!
  • You’re confident with project management, data analysis, and working with ERP/WMS systems to drive decisions and improvements.
  • You can use English as a working language. Fluent writing and reading is acceptable if the rest of your experience is a strong fit.
  • You’re organized, meticulous, and a critical thinker who can communicate clearly and drive results.
  • You’ve worked with SQL, Python, dbt, BI tools, ETL tools like Fivetran or Airbyte, or alerting tools like Monte Carlo or Airflow(not required but a plus).
Couple of the notes about the role
  • This is not a salaried position. This is an Independent Contractor role.
  • This role is only for candidates who are currently based in China.
  • You must be able to commit at least 8 hours per day, 40 hours per week.
  • We require everybody in the team to use Hubstaff () to track hours worked.

Compensation

  • 10-20 EUR/hour + performance bonus + 75 EUR for health stipend on your third month

If you are excited about the opportunity and feel like you are a good fit, we encourage you to apply today and talk to one of our recruiters. We look forward to seeing how your skills and experiences align with our vision.

raw.excerpt: Role OverviewOur client is seeking an experienced Principal Test Lead to head and continuously enhance the organization’s software testing capability while also taking an active leadership role in major strategic initiatives.
raw.description:
Role Overview

Our client is seeking an experienced Principal Test Lead to head and continuously enhance the organization’s software testing capability while also taking an active leadership role in major strategic initiatives. This position combines enterprise-level quality leadership with hands-on project delivery. The successful candidate will shape testing standards and governance across the business while directly leading complex project testing activities. The role requires strong technical testing expertise, proven leadership experience, and deep knowledge of both Agile and traditional software delivery environments.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Functional Leadership

  • Define, implement, and continuously improve the organization’s overall testing strategy, frameworks, and standards.
  • Establish governance processes to ensure consistent quality practices across programs and projects.
  • Promote best practices in quality assurance, including automation and structured test lifecycle management.
  • Lead and mentor test professionals across teams, strengthening overall QA capability and performance.
  • Drive improvements in test planning, execution, reporting, metrics, and quality controls.
  • Partner with Technology, Product, and Business stakeholders to align testing efforts with delivery priorities and timelines.


Project-Level Test Leadership (Hands-On)

  • Lead testing for complex or business-critical initiatives, developing comprehensive test approaches and plans.
  • Oversee execution across functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing phases.
  • Coordinate test environments, test data, and defect management in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Develop and maintain both manual and automated test assets where required.
  • Monitor and communicate testing progress, quality indicators, and risks to stakeholders.
  • Ensure traceability across requirements, test cases, and defect resolution.


Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Identify and evaluate modern testing tools, automation solutions, and emerging technologies (e.g., performance tools, AI-driven testing optimization).
  • Track and report on key quality metrics, using data insights to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Support DevOps and CI/CD practices by embedding automated testing within delivery pipelines.


Required Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in software testing, including at least 3 years in a senior or leadership capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or managing a testing function.
  • Proven ability to oversee QA efforts across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Strong understanding of test lifecycle management, automation practices, and non-functional testing (e.g., performance, security).
  • Hands-on experience with modern QA and automation tools such as XRay, Selenium, Playwright, Azure DevOps, Jira, TestRail, and Jenkins.
  • Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and DevOps methodologies.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and leadership skills.


Desirable

  • Experience building or transforming a testing capability within an organization.
  • Relevant professional certification (e.g., ISTQB Advanced Test Manager or equivalent).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured).
  • Experience with test data management and environment provisioning practices.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic mindset combined with a practical, delivery-focused approach.
  • Strong commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
  • Effective mentor and team leader.
  • Analytical thinker with high attention to detail.
  • Collaborative and adaptable in cross-functional environments.

This is an excellent opportunity for a senior QA professional to influence enterprise-wide testing standards while remaining actively involved in high- impact project delivery.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Digital Marketer to own the digital infrastructure, systems, and execution that support marketing and revenue activity.

This role will take ownership of CRM and HubSpot administration, marketing automation, email nurture programmes, website and CMS management, landing pages, analytics, technical SEO, tracking, and conversion optimisation. You will ensure campaigns and digital journeys are implemented accurately, measured effectively, and continuously improved.

Working closely with the Content Marketing Specialist, you will transform approved messaging and content into effective digital experiences across pages, forms, workflows, email journeys, tracking, reporting, and CRM processes.

This is not a paid-media management role. Success will be driven by reliable marketing systems, an optimised digital customer journey, clear performance visibility, and measurable commercial outcomes.

About the Client

You will be working with an established B2B organisation focused on using effective digital marketing, technology, and data to support sustainable commercial growth. The business values reliable systems, measurable performance, continuous improvement, and strong collaboration between Marketing, Sales, leadership, and technical partners.

Ideal Profile

Essential Experience

  • Ideally 5–7 years of experience across digital marketing, marketing operations, CRM, lifecycle marketing, or a closely related discipline.
  • Demonstrated hands-on ownership of HubSpot and CRM processes within a B2B environment.
  • Experience building and maintaining websites, landing pages, forms, and digital customer journeys through a CMS.
  • Strong experience designing and operating email automation, nurture workflows, segmentation, and lead-routing processes.
  • Proven capability implementing analytics, conversion tracking, dashboards, and campaign measurement.
  • Ability to manage digital initiatives from requirements and build through QA, launch, measurement, and optimisation.

Marketing Systems and Automation Capabilities

  • Advanced working knowledge of HubSpot, including CRM administration, lists, properties, workflows, forms, and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of lead lifecycle management, segmentation, data hygiene, and Marketing-to-Sales hand-offs.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into dependable automated workflows and operating processes.
  • Experience managing platform integrations and troubleshooting data or workflow issues.
  • Strong documentation, quality assurance, and change-management practices.

Website, Analytics and Technical Capabilities

  • Hands-on experience with a modern CMS such as HubSpot CMS, WordPress, or Webflow.
  • Strong knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and dashboarding tools.
  • Practical HTML and CSS knowledge for troubleshooting and routine page-level updates.
  • Working knowledge of technical SEO, structured data, redirects, indexing, and website performance.
  • Experience with conversion optimisation, testing methodologies, and funnel analysis.
  • Ability to interpret complex data and communicate clear commercial implications to non-technical stakeholders.

Systems and Tools

  • HubSpot Marketing Hub and CRM, or comparable marketing automation and CRM platforms.
  • Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Search Console.
  • CMS platforms such as HubSpot CMS, WordPress, or Webflow.
  • Reporting and dashboarding platforms such as Looker Studio or HubSpot reporting.
  • Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets for analysis, validation, and reporting.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience within B2B services, technology, agency, or professional-services environments.
  • HubSpot certifications or demonstrated platform administration expertise.
  • Experience coordinating website improvements with external developers or technical partners.
  • Familiarity with privacy-conscious consent management and email preference processes.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, analytical, and detail-oriented.
  • Proactive in identifying issues and driving them through to resolution.
  • Able to balance technical accuracy, customer experience, and commercial priorities.
  • Reliable, adaptable, and accountable for the performance of owned systems and processes.

Responsibilities

Digital Marketing Planning and Delivery

  • Translate marketing priorities and campaign requirements into practical digital delivery plans.
  • Own the implementation roadmap across the website, CRM, automation, and analytics ecosystem.
  • Coordinate dependencies, testing, approvals, and delivery across Content, Sales, leadership, and technical partners.
  • Identify gaps and areas of friction throughout the digital customer journey and recommend improvements.
  • Maintain accurate documentation for systems, workflows, tracking conventions, and recurring processes.

Website, CMS and Landing Pages

  • Manage the day-to-day administration and continuous improvement of the company website and CMS.
  • Build, format, publish, and maintain landing pages using approved content supplied by the Content Marketing Specialist.
  • Configure forms, calls to action, thank-you experiences, and follow-up journeys.
  • Ensure pages are responsive, accessible, accurate, and aligned with campaign requirements.
  • Manage page updates, redirects, navigation changes, and routine website quality assurance.
  • Coordinate with designers and developers when requirements extend beyond available CMS or no-code capabilities.

HubSpot and CRM Ownership

  • Own the day-to-day administration and continuous improvement of HubSpot and the connected CRM environment.
  • Maintain lifecycle stages, contact properties, segmentation, lists, lead statuses, and data standards.
  • Build and maintain workflows supporting lead capture, qualification, routing, follow-up, and internal notifications.
  • Monitor data quality, duplicate records, field usage, and process adoption, resolving issues proactively.
  • Provide Marketing and Sales with reliable reporting, processes, and visibility throughout the lead lifecycle.
  • Manage relevant integrations and coordinate specialist technical support when required.

Email Automation and Nurture

  • Build and manage automated email journeys, nurture programmes, and trigger-based communications.
  • Transform approved messaging and content into effective email campaigns and automated workflows.
  • Manage segmentation, suppression, enrolment logic, personalisation, and lead hand-offs.
  • Test subject lines, calls to action, sequence structures, and journey design to improve performance.
  • Monitor deliverability, engagement, and conversion performance and implement improvements where required.

Analytics, Tracking and Dashboards

  • Own digital marketing measurement across the website, HubSpot, CRM, and email activity.
  • Implement and maintain analytics, tags, events, conversion tracking, and UTM conventions.
  • Develop dashboards covering traffic, engagement, lead generation, funnel progression, and marketing contribution.
  • Validate tracking before launches and investigate discrepancies or data-quality issues.
  • Translate performance data into actionable recommendations for Content, Sales, and leadership.
  • Deliver regular reporting covering digital performance, key learnings, risks, and priority actions.

Technical SEO and Website Performance

  • Own or coordinate technical SEO requirements beyond the content layer.
  • Monitor crawling, indexing, sitemaps, robots directives, canonicals, redirects, and website errors.
  • Implement schema and structured-data recommendations in collaboration with the Content Marketing Specialist.
  • Support improvements to site architecture, internal linking, and page templates.
  • Monitor website speed, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals, coordinating technical fixes where necessary.
  • Use Google Search Console and relevant tools to identify and address technical issues affecting organic visibility.

Conversion and Journey Optimisation

  • Analyse landing pages, forms, email journeys, and funnel stages to identify friction and drop-off.
  • Develop and execute structured tests across page layouts, forms, calls to action, and journey stages.
  • Use quantitative and qualitative insights to improve conversion performance and user experience.
  • Collaborate with the Content Marketing Specialist on messaging tests while owning technical setup and measurement.
  • Maintain a prioritised optimisation backlog and document outcomes and learnings from completed tests.

How we take care of our team

💰 Get paid in Australian Dollars

🏥 Medical insurance from day one for you + spouse (or parents if unmarried)
🩺 Generous OPD coverage from doctor visits to all your medical needs
🏡 Home office setup allowance to build your ideal workspace
🌐 Internet allowance to keep you connected
💪 Gym & wellness allowance to stay fit and balanced
🎉 Work hard, play hard – regular team events & engagement activities
🧠 Diji Assist – Mental health & counseling support when you need it
📚 We invest in you – reimbursement for industry certifications
🗣️ Open-door culture – your ideas and feedback always matter
🌍 Flexible work – home or office, wherever you do your best work
🏆 Rewards & recognition that actually recognize you
🥳 Great christmas & financial year-end parties to unwind with your loved ones

raw.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

Armada is hiring an early career Commercial Counsel who wants to own deals, not just review them. You’ll be an early hire on a small legal team, working alongside two senior attorneys and reporting directly to the Head of Legal.

This role supports Armada’s commercial growth by drafting and negotiating our customer and procurement agreements, and by partnering closely with GTM, Deal Desk, Engineering, Product, and the rest of the business to keep deals moving while managing risk. You’ll get hands-on transactional experience in a fast-moving AI infrastructure, hardware, and software business.

Location. This role is remote-based in the continental US, with a strong preference for candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones.

What You'll Do:

  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements including NDAs, MSAs, order forms, vendor agreements, reseller and partner agreements, and public sector contracts
  • Manage a steady volume of deals independently, with review at key decision points, escalating matters to our Senior Counsels as necessary
  • Serve as a day-to-day legal partner to the organization, balancing risk against business objectives
  • Apply and maintain Armada’s contract templates and negotiation playbooks, and recommend improvements where you see recurring friction
  • Research and apply evolving legal and regulatory frameworks across AI, hardware, data privacy, and government contracting, escalating where interpretation is unsettled
  • Support international transactions and cross-border data issues in coordination with senior counsel
  • Support hardware sales and as-a-service deals
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on assigned matters, including scoping requests, tracking progress, and summarizing outcomes for internal stakeholders
  • Build strong working relationships across functions and adapt communication style for non-legal audiences
  • Maintain accurate contract records in our CLM and support reporting on deal cycle times and recurring negotiation issues

What You Bring

  • JD from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with at least one US state bar
  • 3+ years of combined law firm and in-house experience supporting commercial transactions
  • 2+ years of in-house experience at a B2B technology company, such as software, hardware, AI, or infrastructure
  • Demonstrated ability to run commercial negotiations independently and close on schedule
  • Sound legal judgment paired with practical business sense
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to public sector or government contracting
  • Familiarity with AI, GPUaaS, hardware, or data center infrastructure
  • Experience with direct or indirect procurement, supply chain, or logistics contracts
  • Experience with export controls (EAR/ITAR) or international commercial transactions
  • Experience with a CLM platform such as Ironclad
  • Experience in a fast-paced, early-stage or high-growth environment
  • Experience or interest in legal operations, such as building intake workflows, playbooks, templates, or AI agents and tools that can help a small team scale

Don't Check Every Box?

Apply anyway. We’re a high-growth startup building a small but mighty legal team, and we care more about judgment, drive, and how you can add value than about checking every box.

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the starting base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).

We use a geographic pay structure based on cost-of-labor markets.

  • Tier 1 (e.g., SF Bay Area, NYC, Seattle): $155,480 – $194,350
  • Tier 2 (most U.S. metro areas): $135,200 – $169,000
  • Tier 3 (other cities): $128,440 - $160,550

Final compensation will be determined by experience, scope, and level, and may vary from the posted range.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized cost)
  • Health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), and dependent care FSAs (DCFSA)
  • Retirement plan options, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k)
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO)
  • 14 paid company holidays per year
Compensation
$135,200—$169,000 USD

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.

Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates

Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. Any resumes submitted by agencies without a prior signed agreement will be considered unsolicited and Armada will not be obligated to pay any fees.

Vālenz® Health is the platform to simplify healthcare – the destination for employers, payers, providers and members to reduce costs, improve quality, and elevate the healthcare experience. The Valenz mindset and culture of innovation combine to create a distinctly different approach to an inefficient, uninspired health system. With fully integrated solutions, Valenz engages early and often to execute across the entire patient journey – from care navigation and management to payment integrity, plan performance and provider verification. With a 99% client retention rate, we elevate expectations to a new level of efficiency, effectiveness and transparency where smarter, better, faster healthcare is possible.

About Our Opportunity
As the VP Sales - TPA Markets (aka VP, TPA Markets), you will be responsible for driving new business growth by developing strategic relationships with third-party administrators (TPAs). You'll develop territory strategies, cultivate new opportunities, and position the Valenz Health platform as a differentiated solution that helps TPAs deliver greater value to their clients. With your assigned territory, you'll be responsible for meeting or exceeding revenue goals while expanding our presence across the TPA marketplace.

To be successful in this role, you'll bring experience selling healthcare, health benefits, or closely related solutions to TPAs and other organizations supporting self-funded employers. You understand the operational and strategic needs of TPAs and have experience building relationships that drive long-term growth.

Things You’ll Do Here:

  • Develop and execute a strategic territory plan to grow Valenz Health's presence within the TPA marketplace.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with executive leaders and key decision-makers at regional and national TPAs.
  • Drive a consultative sales process from prospecting through close by identifying client needs, presenting tailored solutions, negotiating agreements, and achieving or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Position the Valenz Health platform as a strategic solution that enables TPAs to better serve their clients through improved cost management, quality, and member outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing TPA partnerships while developing new relationships with regional and national third-party administrators.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the Valenz Health platform and clearly articulate our value proposition, competitive differentiators, and business impact.
  • Represent Valenz Health at industry conferences, association meetings, and networking events to strengthen market presence and generate new partnership opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Client Success, Operations, and executive leadership to develop winning strategies and support successful partner implementations.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline activity, forecasting, and opportunity management within the CRM while providing regular updates on territory performance and market insights.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:
  • 5+ years of enterprise sales or business development experience selling healthcare, employer benefits, or closely related solutions within the self-funded healthcare market.
  • Demonstrated success developing relationships with regional and national third-party administrators and an understanding of the TPA sales landscape.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals while managing complex, consultative sales cycles.
  • Strong understanding of third-party administration, self-funded employer health plans, and the operational challenges facing TPAs.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and executive relationship-building skills.
  • Highly self-motivated with the ability to independently manage a territory, prioritize opportunities, and drive results.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.

Where You’ll Work:This is a fully remote position outside of the travel requirements, and we’ll provide all the necessary equipment!
  • Travel: Up to 50% to meet with prospective clients, partners, and industry organizations.
  • Work Environment: You’ll need a quiet workspace that is free from distractions.
  • Technology: Reliable internet connection—if you can use streaming services, you’re good to go!
  • Security: Adherence to company security protocols, including the use of VPNs, secure passwords, and company-approved devices/software.
  • Location: You must be US based, in a location where you can work effectively and comply with company policies such as HIPAA.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Valenz is proud to be recognized by Inc. 5000 as one of America’s fastest-growing private companies. Our team is committed to delivering on our promise to engage early and often for smarter, better, faster healthcare.With this commitment, you’ll find an engaged culture – one that stands strong, vigorous, and healthy in all we do.

Benefits

raw.description:
Company Overview

Join us on our mission to elevate customer experiences for people around the world. As a member of the Everise family, you will be part of a global experience company that believes in being people-first, celebrating diversity and incubating innovation. Our dedication to our purpose and people is being recognized by our employees and the industry. Our 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor and our shiny, growing wall of Best Place to Work awards is a testament to our investment in our culture. Through the power of diversity, we celebrate all cultures for their uniqueness and strengths. With 13 centers around the world and a robust work at home program, we believe great things happen when we work with people who think differently from us. Find a job you’ll love today!

Position Purpose:


This role owns the recovery of IT assets — laptops, headsets, peripherals, secure tokens, and related hardware — from departing employees and agents across a distributed, largely work-at-home BPO workforce.

It is an operational leadership role. You will run the end-to-end recovery process, meet recovery-rate and cycle-time targets, tighten the offboarding handoff between HR, Payroll, and IT, and bring fresh thinking to one of the leakiest stages of the asset lifecycle. Success is measured by how much hardware comes back, how quickly, and at what cost — while every action stays compliant with applicable employment law.

Key Responsabilities:


Recovery Operations


  • Manage the full asset-recovery workflow for leavers — voluntary, involuntary, and no-show / abandonment cases — across the work-at-home and on-site workforce.
  • Coordinate reverse logistics: pre-paid return kits, courier pickups, drop-off options
  • Track every device from the separation trigger to physical receipt, and drive down the in-transit and unaccounted population.
  • Handle escalations for non-returners, damaged or incomplete returns, and disputed cases.

Alignment with IT Asset Management

  • Work directly with the ITAM team and their tooling to keep asset status, assignment, and disposition accurate in real time.
  • Reconcile recovered assets against the asset register; ensure returns are checked in.
  • Close the loop with MDM / endpoint tools (Intune) for remote lock.

Coordinate for On-boarding & Offboarding process related to Assets.

  • Own the IT portion of the offboarding runbook, integrated tightly with the HRIS separation trigger so recovery starts on day zero.
  • Build the recovery clock into the exit process — final-pay coordination, return deadlines, and reminder cadence.
  • Reduce leakage at the source through deposit or pledge models, right-sized issuance, BYOD trade-offs, and stronger acknowledgement at the point of asset assignment.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Introduce innovative, cost-effective recovery approaches — self-service return portals, gamified and early-return incentives, automated multi-channel reminders, geofenced device tracking, buy-back and settlement options, and vendor-managed recovery-as-a-service where it pencils out.
  • Use data to surface patterns — which sites, roles, tenure bands, or vendors drive the most loss — and target interventions accordingly.

Legal & Compliance

  • Ensure all recovery actions — final-pay handling, deductions, communications, and any collections — comply with applicable federal, state, and local law across the jurisdictions where the workforce sits.
  • Partner with Legal and HR on non-return escalation paths, settlement letters, and when (and when not) to pursue formal collection.

Reporting

  • Produce recovery dashboards and KPIs for leadership: recovery rate, cycle time, cost per recovery, value recovered versus written off, and aging of open cases.

Attributes & Attitude

  • Proactive and results driven, with strong ownership, sound judgment, and attention to detail. Able to handle sensitive employee situations with professionalism and discretion, coordinate effectively across HR, Payroll, IT, and Legal, and use data to solve problems and improve asset recovery processes.

Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in IT asset management, reverse logistics, endpoint operations, or offboarding, including direct experience in a BPO / contact-centre or large distributed work-at-home environment.
  • Proven track record of measurably improving asset recovery rates and reducing write-offs at scale (thousands of endpoints, high-attrition environments).
  • Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise ITAM / CMDB platform, and comfort working alongside MDM / endpoint-management tools.
  • Excellent cross-functional coordination skills — able to move HR, Payroll, IT, and Legal in the same direction.
  • Data-literate, comfortable in Excel and BI tools building reconciliation and KPI reporting.


Compensation & Benefits:


The anticipated base salary range for this remote position is $70,000. In addition, Everise provides benefits including medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off. Depending on the specific role, compensation may also include commission earnings and other benefit programs. The actual compensation package may vary based on factors such as skill set, experience level, and candidate's location.

If you’ve got the skills to succeed and the motivation to make it happen, we look forward to hearing from you.

Remote Hours: Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST (or based on business needs)

What Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) contributes to Cardinal Health

Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) is responsible for managing the financial lifecycle of patient accounts and ensuring timely and accurate payment for services provided. This job family is focused on a series of clinical and administrative processes that healthcare providers utilize to capture, bill, and collect patient service revenue in a manner that is compliant with payer rules and requirements. The revenue cycle shadows the entire patient care journey and begins with patient intake and ends when the patient’s account balance is zero. This team also encompasses a payer administration function that ensures we are successfully operationalizing payer rules and requirements as well as facilitating payer relations and escalation efforts.


Responsibilities

  • Will be responsible for overseeing the Audit team and responding to all audit requests received by the company in a timely manner in addition to developing and implementing audit processes.
  • The role will focus on quality assurance, quality improvement, and collaborative activities to support company compliance initiatives in accordance with Federal and State regulations.
  • Lead dedicated team responsible for reviewing validity of clinical documentation for accuracy and compile response packets for successful audits.
  • Will work with any additional team members to ensure all tasks are completed in a timely manner and to the highest standards possible.
  • Will provide feedback on successes and failures on a monthly recurring basis and cover areas related to all audit or recoupment inquiries, payor collections inconsistencies, as well as business operations policies and procedures.
  • Oversee all aspects of a TPE, CERT, RAC, pre/post payment, or 3rd party audit & respond in required time frame.
  • Oversee all aspects of a Recoupment or Refund request and respond in required time frame.
  • Monitor, track, and trend all current, in progress, and completed audits.
  • Gather and review all documentation for audits, recoupments, or other documentation requests from insurance companies for accuracy and submission approval.
  • Ensure good communication with CMS and/or other auditors regularly about issues or concerns that arise.
  • Ensure audits, both external and internal, meet all legal requirements and company policies.
  • Review and timely release of all claims marked for QA Review on hold.
  • Assist with development of company policies procedures and enforcing compliance.
  • Perform extensive reviews of accounts to determine if correct payments were made to providers.
  • Review provider contracts/ fee schedules to determine correct payment methodology.
  • Prepare reports summarizing findings and recommending corrective action.
  • Stay up to date on current industry standards and regulations and serve as subject matter expert for Medicare updates and educational trainings.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 4-8 years of experience, preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred
  • Leadership, project management, or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Urology or wound care product knowledge preferred

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Coordinates and supervises the daily activities of operations or business staff
  • Administers and exercises policies and procedures
  • Ensures employees operate within guidelines
  • Decisions have a direct impact to work unit operations and customers
  • Frequently interacts with subordinates, customers, and peer groups at various management levels
  • Interactions normally involve information exchange and basic problem resolution

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan

  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs
